dgon par gdan drang yong ba de ni dngos gnas ya mtshar ba zhig ste phyi'i bzo bkod kyi rnam pa kho nas kyang mi la dad sems dbang med du slong zhing mi rnams rang nyid kyi dus rgyun smon pa byed sa'i gnas der sleb pa'i 'khrul snang sogs ster ro/phyi dro yas mas kyi mtshams su nga tsho mchod gnas rnams chab cig tu sgor phebs shing spro spro tsam byed skabs pa'i mig lam la 'du khang chen mo'i mdun dang g.yas g.yon sogs na star phreng bsgrigs yod pa'i rlangs 'khor ru khag cig mngon byung / rlangs 'khor 'di dag gi phyi ngos su gos chen dang lag dar gyis brgyan 'dug cing nang rtsa che ba'i dngos po 'bor chen gyis kheng 'dug/drang mor bshad na/bla sprul dag dang mi phal ba'i bar gyi khyad par yang 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i gnad la brten nas byung zin zhes bshad na mi chog pa med snyam mo/ dgung mo'i dus tshod dgu tsam gyi skabs su smon lam chen mo yar 'tshogs byas shing mjug mtha'i zhal 'debs 'bul mgo brtsams/ tshogs gral nas dge bskos kyis btsan gtam bshad de byis pa 'ga' phyir 'gro ru bcug/thos pa ltar na kho tsho ma 'ong bar grwa ba byed ched dgon pa 'di na yod pa'i rang rang gi nye 'brel grwa rgan 'ga'i gam na bod yig sbyang bzhin yod la de dgung smon lam chen mo'i mjug mtha'i zhal 'debs la dmigs te 'dir zhugs mod/'on kyang dge bskos kyis ngos zin byung stabs dmigs yul ma 'grub pas mig mdun gyi don 'di byung bar bshad/ don dngos yin pa'i snang tshul 'di mthong rjes bdag sems sdug gis khengs zhing mig mthar mchi ma 'khyil song / de yang rang gi mi tshe gang bo'i mdun lam la bsam gzhigs phran tsam yang ma btang b.rardzuchos sgor zhugs pa〉zhes ba'i tha snyad bzang bo 'di'i sna drang ste mi tshe'i 'gro phyogs gzhan zhig tu bsgyur ba dang 'khor ba dang bde sdug nges 'byung nges shes sogs kyi tha snyad 'di dag gi don — 158 —

phar zhog tshig thos pa tsam zhig kyang med bzhin 'khor ba las thar zin pa'i chas spras la nye ba'i grwa chung 'di dag gi dka' kheg mthong ba'i rkyen gyis so/de nas cang ma 'gor bar smon lam gyi tshogs gtso dag gis gtam bshad dang sprul grwa jo gsum gyis 'ur sgra'i khrod ming du grags pa'i sham bha la mthunasmosgril smonalam rta/ mo〉zhekā payongakā snamajug rdzogs so/ / ngoyin shā sna/ ༵ / zlo ༵sa skazlo sdu ṭ+wāṃ shāṭākā wasna trīji // ga ngas da dung —ga ra

bud med dus deb las 'phros pa'i tshor snang/dus rabs/ nyer gcig gi sne khrid pa'i de rang 'dir nga tsho'i mig lam du nyam thag pa'i dus deb 'ga' mngon byung / de ni nga tsho bod kyi shes ldan phru gu rnams kyis skyed yum mam yang na tsho khag 'di'i rigs rgyud phyi ma zhig gi srog shing du gyur pa 'gas dus deb red/ dus deb 'di dag mthong tshe nga la rang dbang med par stong ba nyid du gyur ba'i tshor snang zhig byung la yid sems skyo ba'i kheng ste mig chu 'thor de'i rgyu mtshan bud med dus deb 'di dag kher rkyang gi dus deb yin la kher rkyang dus deb las gsal ba'ang kher rkyang gi bsam blo dang na zug re smon phug 'dun sogs kyang kher rkyang gi chos 'ba' zhig yin pas so/ dus deb 'di dag ma spel ba'i snga rol du kher rkyang gi lam bu 'di brgyud mkhan gtso bo bu mo'i mig chu rtsom pa po bde skyid sgrol ma dang / byi ru'i las dbang rtsom pa po gzungs phyug skyid/ sgrung ring thung ci rigs rtsom mkhan me sgron/ dpal mo/ 'od zer mtsho/ g.yu zhun/ lu gu skyid/ bcas dang 'di dang mnyam du lam bu 'di brgyud grogs su gyur ba skyed yum dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa mkha' mo rgyal/skyo snang gi zlos gar rtsom pa po tshe sgron skyid/ rtsom rigs dpyad gleng mkhan gangs 'tsho/ sogs red kho mo tsho la ma cig lab sgron gyi mdzad chos tshang la myang tsha dkar rgyan gyi snying stobs ldam/ de'i phyir ma 'ong bod rigs bu mo shes yon can gyi mig dpe yin la da yod bod rigs bu mo shes yon can gyi sne khrid mkhan/ ngas 'dir nyam thag dang kher rkyang sogs kyi ming tshig d+ngha 160 ——

rnam sa bud med kyi steng du bkol don bod rigasabud med tsho kher rkyang dang mgrod lam de 'ang kher lam yin pa'i gnad la thug yod/ gsal bor bshad na/ chos phyogs nas/ bslab bya gser 'gyur las/ bstan pa bshig pa'i thog rgod yin/ /bstan 'dzin brlag pa'i dug nag yin/ /zhes pa/bud med dang /'jig rten phyogs nas/khyi bud med gnyis la blo gtad med//skra ring ma dang blo thung ma sogs bud med la go dgos pa red/ de'i phyir nga tsho chos ldan bod kyi yul gru chen po 'di nas nyam thag pa ni bud med tsho red la kher rkyang gi go gnas can yang bud med tsho rid des na kho tsho'i blo rtsal las thon pa'i rtsom yig phyogs bsgrigs dus deb tu grub pa la'ang kher rkyang dus deb dang nyam thag dus dus deb ces 'bod rigs so/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas/ dus deb 'di dag mthong tshe nga la rang dbang med par gces nor rtsa chen bor zin pa zhig phyir thob pa lta bu'i tshor snang byung la yid sems dga' spro'i khengs ste thal mo rdel la/de'i rgyu mtshan bud med dus deb 'di dag bsam blo dang snying stobs mtshon byed du gyur yod par ma zad mi rigs kyi mdun lam gleng byed gleng stegs bu zhig tu 'ang gyur yod pas so/ngas mthong ba'i dus deb ni nyis stong gsum lo'i deb dang po skyed yum dang nyis stong lnga lo'i deb dang po sgrol ma zhes pa gnyis yin la dus deb 'di gnyis las bud med rtsom mkhan rnams kyis smra brjod rang dbang ldan pa'i ngang tshigs bcad lhug spel ma sogs kyi sgo nas bsam 'char sna tshogs sped pa med par brjod yod pa/ dper na rma kha' mo rgyal gyis bris pa'i skyed yum dbu tshugs pa dang rims mtshos bris pa'i rims kyi satam rgyud/ yang mkha' mo rgyal gyis bris pa'i a ma phyug po dang a ma t+nasdol/ bo sogs dang bud med zhig gi sems 'gyu phra mo/ gangs ri'i dpa' — 161 —

6ri'/ 65malasasadā/ rang slob grwara'agro'adod—/ldeṅgerganalasasadā zlo rtedalabala' drin che zhu/ drang bden/ bu mo'i re smo na/ mi rigs kyi mdzangs ma khyed sang la bzhud song / sring chung ma'i las dbang dus rabs nyer sacig pa'i blo sgo/ skor lam gyi mthong thos/ lta bu sogs so/ ga'an nga tsho su 4 yang 'os 'gan yod la 'os 'gan yang rang la 'tsham pa de yin de'i phyer bdag sgas 'os 'gan bud med dus deb 'di dag la lta tshul brjod rgyu de ma yin mod 'on kyang bdag la tshor snang mi 'dra ba'i rigs de dag byung rkyen rang sga lta tshul dag yig ngor bkod pa yin/mthar bud med dus ṣ+ṭṛb kyi ṭ+wāṃ nang gak+tos kyi rgyu spus yod tshad gong ṭ+wāṃs goṭ+wāṃ du speldu mkhan snosdu sde kā ༵dā spyirno ༵ ṭ+wāṃ byesdo ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ drok+tab kā da//ba//nga 'ad+nghar ba— yum chon dag ma

mi rigs 'ga'i chos lugs dang smong dad byed min gleng ba/dang po bon po'i chos lugs kyi skor bshad pa/ bod srol rgyun rig pa dang 'brel ba gting zab yin pa'i bon chos ni gangs can pa'i rgyal bo thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i snga rol nas dmangs khrod du dar yod la ngo bo bshad dka' zhing rnam pa mtha' yas su gnas ba zhig yin/ da lta bsanu na ston pa gshen rab kyi gsung chos la theg pa'i go rim dgu dang snying bo snying rje chen po sogs kyis rim pa bzhag tu yod par grags pas de'i cha nas nang bstan chos lugs dang mi 'dra ba'i rtags bkod dka' snyam/yin na yang bka' thang las/rgyal bo'i sku'i rim gror lha cha dgos zer bon po'i g.yag lug gsod/ zhes dang dung dkar tshang gi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa zhes par/ bon gyi theg dgu chos kyi theg dgu gnyis/ /lo tsā rnams kyis 'gegs res byed bcug pas/ /zhes dang ban bon gyi chos lugs gnyis po me chu dang snang mun 'phrad pa nang bzhin 'gal zla yin pa gsal bshad byas 'dug phyir dpyad rgyu gal che'o/ spyir rmongs dad ni mi rigs kyis bsam blo'i nor 'khrul la bsten nas byung phyir da skabs rang rgyal du yod pa'i mi rigs khag so so nas rang rang gi chos lugs la rmong dad byed tshul 'dra mnyam/ du yo da/ bon chos bod la dar ba'i dbang gis bod mi tsho'i nam mkha'i lha dang mo rtsis 'u nga gsum la skyabs bcol ba dang /cho ga sna tshogs chos kyis byed sgor rlom pa sogs spyi tshosas gseb tu tshab chen rang bzhin gyi rmong dad kyis khyab 'dug /der ma zad da dung rjes su — 163 —

'phags yu la gyi chos bod la dar bar brten blun po rnams kyi rmong dad byed yu la je mang du song nas mthar dad pa zhes pa rang kho na'i zhen phyosas tsam du 'ang snang ngo/ gnyis pa sog po'i chos lugs kyi skor bshad pa/sogs rigs kyi chos lugs ni/ mang che ba'i nang bstan chos lugs dang gcig yin par snyam 'dug gnad don 'dir rgyu mtshan gtan nas med pa ma yin te/ de yang hor rgyal gong ma 'ga'i sku ring la bod na ming grags che ba'i chos lugs pa gtso bo rnams gdan drang nas phan chun yon mchod kyi 'brel ba btsugs pa'i lo rgyul la bsam na gsal bor shes thub/ 'on kyang don du sog yul rang la yang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos lugs shig yod pa sme bdun skar ma'i mdo'i mjug tu/tu'u hu nyid kyang sngon chad sog po'i chos lugs 'dzin pa la chos 'di'i byin rlab kyis rjes su/ zhes sogs bris pa kho nas kyang mtshon par nus/nang bstan chos lugs sog yul du ma dar sngon nas bzung gnam la mgo gtad pa dang thog 'brug klog gsum gnam gyi bka' bkyon du bgrangs ba bcas rnam pa tha dad pa'i rmongs dad ldan par bshad do/ gsum pa hos ho'i chos lugs kyi skor bshad pa/hos rigs kyi chos lugs 'di yang a la po'i yul nas tshur dar bar grags la/ kha che'i chos lugs zhes kyang 'bod bzhin 'dug nang bstan chos gzhung las mu steg par cha 'dra ba'i chos lugs red zer/ kho bos bsam par/ srog gcod kyi las thabs la mkhas pa'i phyogs nas kla klo'i chos lugs dang 'dra la phyi phyogs nas yod pa'i rdo nam mkhar gnas pa la mchod skor byed pa'i thad nas mu steg pa'i chos lugs dang 'dra snyam/ hos mi tsho'i nang khul du'ang thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad tshul zhig yod par 'dug rkyen da dung dpyad na bzang la/ mi rigs 'dir yang thun min gyi rmongs dad byed tshul zhig yod na ma gtogs phal che ba 'dra bar snang bas — 164 —

zhib 'bri byed pa'i nga' ba ma byas par bzhag so /mdor dril na chos lusas kyi ngo bo dus rabs dang mthun par dar spel byed pa dang / rmongs dad kyi ngo bo sad snyigs dang 'dra bar rtsad sprug byed dbos la/ de ltar byas pa'i mjug du/da gzod nga tsho'i 'od 'bar 'phro ba'i lam phran dang /gnas lugs ldan pa'i chos lugs shig tshegs med ngang rnyed thub bo////

chos 'jig rten gnyis so so yin tshul gleng ba/de yang 'o ngo grangs med zhig gi yar sngon du ma tshan snya na gyi grags pa gling bzhir ldir ba'i rlab chen gyi rgyal bo rnams pa dang po ti yi grangs ka dgung dang mnyam pa'i 'phags chen gyi skyes bu rnam pa sogs bgrang las 'angs pa zhig byon te sngar med pa'i byas rjes go la hril bo'i ngos su mig mthong lag zin gyi tshul du bzhag 'on kyang 'di yod tshad 'das tshar ba yin pa'i bzang ngan gang ltar kyang nga tsho la dgos pa med phyir nye ba'i lo 'ga' zhig gi nang 'das zin pa'i don rkyen dag la dgas sgrub kyi rtsom yig gang mang spel ba dus deb dang tshag par sogs su ha kyang mod/ yin na yang da lta nga tsho'i da lta'i gnas bab la gzhi bcol te de'i skor gleng byar 'dzin rgyu gal che ma gtog gzhan snga rabs pa'i byung ba bshad nas nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed pa ni ngal ba'i rgyu 'ba' zhig las dgos don yod pa cher ma mthong / dus rab nyer gcig pa'i gzhi dkyil nas nyer gnyis par kha phyogs pa'i ska bas 'dir nga tsho da dung sngon ltar bo med tshor med ngang gnas na dus nam zhig la sngon thon gyi lam po che ru mi rigs zhig gi la rgya mkha' la bsgrengs thub/ kho bo'i bsam na dam pa'i chos la bsgrub lugs dang 'jig rten 'khor ba skyong lugs zhig yod pa'i gsham du bdag gi de'i skor 'ga' zhig klogs mkhan mkhyen spyan yangs ba dag gi spyan lam du 'bul bar bya'o/ /de yang nye ba'i lo 'khor 'ga' zhis gi ring la mkhas pa dze+e /ṭ+wāṃ6 pharda tshun la dgag sgrub kyi spros pa sna tshogs phul dang 'bul

bzhin yod pa ni dang len byed dgos pa'i don zhig yin mod 'on kyang dgon grong dmangs khrod dag na spel bzhin pa'i dus deb dang / tshags par 'di dag gis nga tsho'i mi rigs yar rgyas su 'gro byed kyi thabs lam mi gleng bar bla ma ga ge mo zhig gi rnam thar dang dgon pa'i che chung gra ba'i mang nyung sku gsung thugs rten rtsa chen yod tshul dmangs glu rog mthun pho mo chags sred kyi sgrung gtam sogs bshad mi tshar ba'i nyog gtam lung ba gang spel bzhin sdod pa ni mkhas pa'i bya ba las rab tu 'das de byis pa rtsed chas la dga' ba dang chos mtshungs bar dam pa rnams yi mug pa'i gnas su 'khums so/ /des na/ kha min don kyis bod pa'i dar rgud dang 'pho 'gyur bsam pa yin tshe ma 'ong 'byung 'gyur la zhib 'jug rgya chen po zhig byas te da lta'i mdun gyi kha rgyab kyis gnad don thag gcod byed dgos phran chung bdag gi bsam tshul ltar na mi rigs zhig yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i gnad 'gag gtso bo nang bsam pa'i dpal yon la rag las yod de'i rgyu mtshan mi gcig la cha mtshon na nang bsam pa'i go rtogs je tsam du je mthor song na phyi dngos po bkol spyod de tsam du byed thub pa yin la phyi dngos po bkol spyod ci tsam du byed thub na phyi nang gnyis gang thad nas yar rgyas su 'gro thub pa yin/ de'i phyir slob gso'i myong ba zab mo zhig rmang gzhir bzung nas ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam dam 'dzin byed dgos/ slob gso ni chos lugs slob gso dang 'jig rten slob gso gnyis yin la de yang nga tsho'i mi rigs ni sngon nas da bar du chos dad byed mkhan mi rigs dag gi gras su gtog pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos lugs slob gso thog mar myong dgos pa bshad ma dgos/ de'i phyir nang bstan chos lugs kyi rin thang ngo ma zhig rgya khyab rong 'brog mang tshogs dang gsar byung rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig la ngo sprod kyi tshul du smra ba la/ /mdo las/ chos ni sdi67 —

shes bya lam dang ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'das ma byas/ /ces sosas sgra thog sa bcu tsam yod pa las 'di ni dam sgra thog pa'i chos de yin no/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo las/ /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag bo/ /zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ /chos thams cad stong zhing bdas med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba'o/ /zhes gsungs ba'i don de'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi ngo bo ngo ma de sna mi 'dra ba'i chos lugs brgya phrag kha shas kyis rang gi go gnas sra brtan du gtong ched du bsgrub bzhin pa dag las rab tu 'das de spyi dmangs la phan pa dang shes bya'i gnas tshul ji bzhin du rtogs byed kyi thabs lam nyag gcig yin pa yang gsal bshad byas yod /des na gsar byung sgyug thog pa 'gas nang bstan chos lugs la yang dag par dad pa rmongs dad yin par smra ba ma rig pa la skyabs bcol ba'i log bshad kho na las ma 'das ma ni gong gsal gyi don de tsam gyis kyang mtshon nus so/'on kyang a lags dang grub chen zer ba tshos ci bshad tshad ma nyag gcig tu brtsis te rgyob zer na a ba'i mgo dang / rgyug zer na gshin rje'i 'phrangs/zhes pa'i rjes su 'jug pa ni phyogs so sor khyab che ba zhig ste dper na/ kho bo'i pha yul du 'ang grub chen dang a lags yin zer ba rnams kyis ci bshad tshad mar brtsis nas sen mgo rnag dang sen rting khrag byas nas thob pa'i sgor mo yod tshad sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs ched dang dgon pa'i rgya je cher gtong phyir 'bul bzhin yod pa'i rang gi bsam par dge ba rgya chen zhig 'grub yod snyam kin 'dug mod don du gzhan gyis snyan grags rgyas phyir du 'bad bzhin pa'i bya bar rgyab skyor byas pa tsam las dge rtsa yod med ngas brgya go gcig chod kyi sdom tshig 'god mi dgos par khyed tsho rang rang gi bsam blo thongs dang go rgyu chen po yod/ der ma zad da cha nga tsho'i dge ba bskub khul du rlom bzhin gson — 168 —

po'i rim gror seng gdung bsgrub thabs dang phur ba'i bsgrub thabs gzhan srung ma'i bskang gsol sogs 'don pa lta bu dang gshin po'i dge rtsar kar gling zhi khro 'don pa'i mtshon/ bod yul mun pa'i gling 'di'i sa gnas 'ga' zhig du lab rtse jiṭa pa bsang chen 'bul ba dus chen 'ga' zhig gi nang du dus mchod byed pa yin zer nas sems can du ma dmar gsod byas te yon mchod gnyis kyis sha khrag yid tshim pa re rol zhor 'di phyi'i legs nyes mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub par snyam pa sogs ni nang bstan chos lugs kyi lta sgom spyod gsum gyi lam/las rgyang ring du gyur ba'i kha phyogs ngan pa'i snang tshul mtshar bo zhig red chos bsgrub pa yin zer zhor nyam thag srog ldan 'gro ba'i bde sdug la mi lta bar bsad gtub ci nus byed pa dang gzhan yang yon bdag dbul phyug kun gyi dpal 'byor chud zos su gtong ba'i byed las de ni nang ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i ngo bo dang mthun nam mi mthun spyir rgyun ldan gyis 'tsho ba'i khrod du dgon sde che chung khag gi bsgrub thabs che ma chung gsum dang phyag lan sna kha sne mo'i rigs 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa dang lha sde che chung khag gi lha glu gnyan gsum mchod bstod dang mo rtsis lung gsum gzhi rtsar bsten pa sogs byas nas chos lugs kyi bya 'gul spel bar rlom pa ni nor 'khrul tshab chen zhig red/de'i phyir chos bsgrubs pa dang chos la dad pa sogs byed dgos na ma mtha' yang dad pa'i ngo bo dang chos kyi kha phyogs sogs khong du chud thabs byed dgos/ da lta rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus skabs su ston pa shākya mu ne lta bu'i chos pa med la mgon med zas sbyin lta bu'i yon bdag kyang med/ de'i phyir yon mchod phyogs so so nas mchod gnas rnams kyis chos lugs kyi dbang shed la kha g.yar nas yon bdag gi rgyu nor ham len byed mi rung la/ yon bdag rnams kyis chos lugs kyi dngos don ma rtogs par — 169 —

yod tshad lha la 'bul ba'i glen rtags de bas kyang byed mi rung / kho bo'i rtsom 'di 'bri bzhin pa'i sgang la chos grogs zhig bi khyod kyis seng phur sogs bsgrub thabs skor dang bsang mchod lab rtse sogs dgos med du sma don ci zhes the tshom dang bcas dris byung red de kho bo'i chos grogs 'di gtso ba'i mi mang shos shig long gsal gyi don der mi 'thad pa'i tshul 'dug 'di la 'di ltar smra bar bya ste/nga tsho'i 'don bzhin pa'i seng gdong bsgrub thabs lta bu gcig la cha mtshon na/ dang bo skyabs sems nas spyan 'dren mchod 'bul sogs yan lag bdun pa dang de nas bzlas sngag 'don pa'i bar du theg chen mdo sngag gnyis las sngag gyi theg pa 'og ma 'ga' zhig gi nyams su len tshul dang mtshungs la da dong rang nyid lha ru gsal dgos pa'i thabs lam yang shin du mang ba'i phyogs su gnas/ de min kar gling zhi khro lta bur cha mtshon na/bskyed rjogs gnyis kyi gdeng dang ldan dgos par ma zad beg chen sngag gyi lam gong ma'i rtsis zin dgos da dung gshin po'i rjes su 'don na gshin po de 'gro ba rigs drug gang la yang 'khyams mi bcug par thar ba'i sa la sngags dang ting 'dzin gyi nus pa la bsten nas spar thabs byed dgos des na nga tsho rang rang 'khor ba las ma thar bzhin gzhan thar bar 'god pa'i nus pa yod dam med 'di ltar bsam blo btang na da gzod da tsho'i go ba dngos ma zhig lon mi yong ngam/ bsang chen 'bul ba dang lab rtse rtsig par cha mtshon na dgra bla'i ngo so bstod thabs dang gzhi bdag btsan po mgu thabs gzhan rta rgyug mda' 'phen dang glu len gar rtse sogs srol rgyun ltar du yod pa'i bya ba tsam las dgos mkho ci zhig 'dug/'di dag las rta rgyug lta bur mtshon na nyam chung dud 'gro'i rigs rtsed spyad byas pa kho na ma gtog don ci zhig mtshon thub 'di'i rigs la dga' zhen che ba'i mi dang yang na chos pa zhig la bsang — 170 —

mchod 'bul ba sogs la dgos pa che 'bring chung gsum ci lta bu zhig ngo da ces dris zin pa'i dbang du btang na/ kho tsho'i sngar mes po gong ma'i ring la dar khyab che ba'i srol bzang yin tshul 'di phyi'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi rtsa yin tshul sogs lab zhor dga' krog krog byed par 'dug mod gnas lugs ltar bshad na byed sgo 'di'i nang bstan chos lugs kyis lta sgom spyod gsum gyi cha dang bod chen po'i srid 'byor rig gsum gyi cha sogs gang la yang phan thog ci zhig 'byung ste tha na mtshon byed tsam du 'jog mi rung ba mngon gsal ma red dam/de'i phyir kho bo'i gong du bshad zin pa'i don de rigs la/ gal bo che nan tan dang / /dam pa'i chos brgya tshar gyi/ /dpe ltar bskyar zlos zhig dang lhan du kha skong zhig kyang byas yod pa'i khyed rnams pa'i bsam blo re gtong dgos pa'i re ba zhu/ /mthar 'di tsam kyis 'thus par byas nas 'jig rtenatsāb gso'i skor rag tsam zhig gleng khul du bya'o/ /de yang sum nyis sa yi khyon la zhabs rjes dang phyag rjes 'god myong ba'i mes dpon gong ma rnams dang mi rigs hril bo'i las don la bcos bsgyur dang dag ther byed pa'i gsar byung mkhas pa rnams sogs la rjes su yi rang dang bka' drin che zhu ba las gzhan khong tsho'i byed phyogs dang thabs lam de dang du blang nas da lta'i rjes lus kyi mi rigs 'di'i las dbang la bcos bsgyur dang bsam blo la sne khrid byed pa ni bla dpon rnams pa'i thob sprad pa dang mang tshogs rnams kyis 'dem shog 'phangs ba lta bu zhig ma yin par dus rabs dkar bo 'di'i sprad pa'i 'os 'gan nyag gcig yin/ desan da skabs kyi chos pa phal mo che zhig gi 'dod tshul dang bshad tshul ltar na chos lugs dang tshan rig kha 'bral mi rung ba dang zung 'brel yin pa'i skor 'ba' zhig gleng bzhin 'dug 'di'i thad nas nga'i bsam tshul ltar na spyir khyed rnams pa'i nang bstan chos — 171 —

lugs kyi rin thang rtogs yod pa ha kyang bzang tshod red/ yin na yang bod kyi mkhas dbang bgrangs las 'das pa du ma'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi rin thang phan nus byed las ngo bo sogs phyogs so so nas ngo sprod dang brgyud sgrogs byas yod pa de las gzhan nga tsho'i 'tsho gnas 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs la yang chos lugs med mi rung bar sgrogs pa 'di ni ngo tsha ba dang zhe mer ba zhig ma red dam/ de'i rgyu mtshan spyi tshogs kyi chos lugs la shugs rkyen theb pa ma yin par chos lugs kyi sbyi tshogs za bzhin pa lta bur snang ba 'di ni chos lugs pa rnams kyis chos la kha g.yar te mang tshogs la mgo skor dang lha sde la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i bsam blor brten nas byung ba'i don zhig yin/ de min khong rnams pa chos pa rnal ma zhig yin na chos la brten nas 'jig rten bsgrubs pa'i ngang tshul de dang du len mi srid la lhag par du 'jig rten gyi 'dod yon ma spang bar chos bsgrubs tshul zhig ston pa rin po che mchog gis kyang dang len byed ma myong ba ni 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i rgyal sa bamyur nas dben ri la byon pa'i mdzad rnams ltar ro/mdo las/ khyed la chung ma bu dang bu mo med/ /bran pho bran mo med kyang dbang phyugs med/ /khyim dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyang yod ma yin/ /rab tu byung nas rtsod par ma byed cig /ces gsungs ba'i dgong don ltar bsam blo btang na 'jig rten bsgrub mkhan gyi gang zag sus kyang chos 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i skabs dang gnas med la/ yang gong gsal theg pa 'og ma'i nyams len byed lugs de lta na theg pa 'bring dang chen por de bas kyang gting zab pa rgya che ba grangs mang ba'i tshul du yod pa'i chos kyi lam de la gnas pa'i dam pa'am 'phags pa'i skyes bu su zhig gis chos 'jig rten bsgrub byed kyi lag cha dang 'jig rten chos bsgrubs pa'i gnas gzhi byed srid mi la ras pa ni rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug lor 'tshar long byung — 172 —

ba'i bod kyi chos pa ngo ma zhig yin khong gi sku tshe gang bor dka' spya da ci 'dra zhig byas yod pa mgur glu dag las gsal bor mtshon thub/ chos dang 'jig rten tha dad du yod pa'i gnas lugs 'di khong gi lta ba'i bzhed dgong mthar thug pa red spyir bden rdzun gnyis kyi rkya 'thab pa la brten nas yang na ngo ma 'am yang na rdzun ma ste gang rung gi phyogs su lhung ba ni 'jig rten gyi gshis su gnas pa'i don yin de'i phyir rje btsun chen po'i mthar thug gi phan 'bras 'byung ba'i gzhi rtsa yang gong gsal gyi don 'di yin la nang bstan chos lugs kyi ngo bo thun mong ma yin pa mtshon byed kyi gnad 'gag kyang 'di la thug yod/de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan du ma'i dbang gis nang bstan chos lugs 'jig rten pa'i 'tsho gnas kyi thad du dgos med yin pa kha gsal lag gsal gyi don dngos snang tshul te 'jig rten pa rnams ni 'jig rten rkyang rkyang bsgrub mkhan zhig yin na da gzod 'tsho ba don snying can zhig rol thub nges yin/ 'di ltar bshad pa'i mjug thogs su mi gang mang zhig gi bsam par 'o na mes dpon rnams gsum sogs rgyal chen gong ma dag gi sku ring la chos 'jig rten mnyam 'brel byas pa ma yin nam snyam pa'i dog pa 'char srid yin na yang skabs de'i chab srid la dbang bsgyur byed mkhan gyi mi sna tshor mtshon na chos nyams su len pa'i chos pa rkyang ma zhig gtan nas ma yin par bod chen mo'i srid 'byor rig gsum gyi las don bsam pa'i mi bu phal ba 'ba' zhig yin khong tsho'i thugs rgyud dang mos pa byed las sogs kyi cha nas lha 'dre gang rung gi sprul bar kha tshon bcad pa ma gtog don ngo ma'i steng nas kho tsho yang sma shes don bo mi'i rigs su gnas pa zhig las gzhan ma yin pa da lta yang nga tsho'i spyod pa mi bzang ba dang bsam pa ngan par gnas pa tsho la 'dre 'dre mo'i tha snyad 'dogs pa dang de las ldos pa'i rigs su phyogs yod pa — 173 —

rnams la lha lha mo'i tha snyad sbyor bar byed pa'i don 'di la brten nas rjes su dpog thub/ de'i phyir kho ba tsho'i chos la chos kyi rin thang yod pa'i cha nas lha chos kyi khrim srol gtso bor bshad yod la 'jig rten la 'jig rten gyi rin thang yod pa'i cha nas mi chos kyi khrim srol gtso bor bshad yod/khong tsho ni chos lugs la brten nas 'jig rten dbang du bsgyur mkhan zhig min la mchog gsum skyabs su 'dzin pa'i nang ba'i yon bdag gi tshul du bzhugs yod pa zhig yin/'on kyang kho tsho'i dus der chos srid zung 'brel gyi rtsa ba'i cha rkyen grub yod pa mkhas dbang dung dkar tshang gis chos srid zung 'brel gyi skor bshad pa zhes bar ha kyang gsal la lha chos mi chos gnyis las lha chos gtso bor byed pa'ang ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang bka' thang shel brag ma phyis su byung ba'i chos 'byung 'ga' sogs su zhib mor bris 'dug de'i rkyen gyis nga cag bod pa rnams 'jig rten skyong mkhan zhig dang gtan nas mi 'dra la rtsa ba'i gnad gcig tsam zhig kyang rtogs mi 'dug ces bshad chog de'i phyir nga tsho'i da nas bzung 'jig rten phyogs kyi shes byar do snang dang slob sbyong byed pa chos lugs phyogs kyi bya 'gul je nyung du gtong ba sogs byas na 'tsho ba rol bar phan thog 'byung srid snyam/'di nas nges par du bshad dgos pa zhig la ngas ni dus nam yang khyed tsho la chos yang dag ma yin zhes bshad ma myong la bshad kyang mi srid gal te bshad na'ang rang nyid kyi rmong rtags phyir bstan pa kho na yin/ 'on kyang chos 'jig rten gnyis ni me chu nang bzhin 'gal bar grub phyir de tha dad / bsgrubs dgos zhes bshad pa dag kho bos dus nam hārjosdo slo/ //sdo ṅge/ga/ tu mi bsam la ma 'ongs ba na'ang yang nas yang du — /71 —

bden gtam pad dkar chun po/sems ldan gyi tshe srog la do snang bya dgos pa'i skor bshad pa//de yang bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su gnas pa'i rang re bod mi rigs la mtshon na 'tshe med gzhan phan gyis byed las la goms yod pa zhig du kun gyis smra bzhin yod/ yin na yang da lta de las ldog te 'gro ba sems ldan gyi tshe srog la rgol ba rtsom pa'i bya ngan de sa khyab rdo khyab tu 'gro bzhin yod par ma zad lce'i bro ba mngar mo tsam myang ba'i phyir du nyam chung dbugs ldan nor lug khri khri 'bum 'bum gyis tshe srog la gnod 'tshe gtong kin 'dug /'di ni chos phyogs nas bshad na/ srog ldan gyi 'gro ba kun pha mar ma gyur ba med pa dang / srog gcod gong na sdig gzhan med tshul/ ston pa'i bka' bstsal ba/ de dang 'gal ba'i spyod ngan zhig yin la/ 'jig rten gyi phyogs nas bshad na/rang don kho na'i ched du gzhan la gnod pa byed pa'i rigs la nga tsho'i 'dre dang spyang ni zhes pa'i tha snyad ngan pa 'dog par ma zad 'jigs rung gi gnas su 'dzin par byed pa de ltar nga tsho rang nyid kyis kyang rang gis tshed du gzhan la gnod 'tshe byas na mtshang ming ngan pa 'byor bar ma zad 'jig rten pa'i lugs srol dang 'gal ba'i spyod ngan zhig kyang yin no/de'i phyir smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen tshul khrim blo gros mchog gis/ 'di'i skor la thugs khur byas pa'i gsung rtsom gang mang yod pa rnams dang nyam chung 'gro ba sems can srog bslu byas pa'i mdzad rnam bzang bo la/ nga tsho'i kha mig yar lta byas te/ gangs ljongs bod yul la spyod — /75 —

bzang 'di nyid dar spel rgya cher gtong bar byed pa la/ mdo dbus khams gsum na gnas pa'i bod pa skya ser pho mo kun gyis thog mar rang lus nas mgo brtsam te bsam blo zhig gtong rogs zhu/de'i rgyu mtshan ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/rang gi lus la dpe long la//gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig/zhes gsungs ba ltarang tsho rang steng nas che ba mgo bo bcad pa dang 'bring ba rkang lag bcad pa tha ma sha leb mo tsam bcad pa tshun chad bzod mi nus ba ltar gzhan gyis kyang bzod mi nus pa la 'dra mtshungs yin 'on kyang nga tshor mtshon na gzhan srog gcod pa'i skabs su 'dzem dog ci yang med la rang nyid kyis thun gcig gi bkres skom tsam yang bsran mi nus 'di ni gdong dmar srin po'i khyu gcig 'jig rten 'dir mngon sum du sleb pa yin la 'di bzhin mar la song na nyam chung sems ldan 'gro bar bde skyid nyag gcig kyang 'byung mi thub de'i phyir nga tsho'i gong gsal ltar bsam blo zhib mo re btang na sbyod bzang 'di nyid dar spel gtong ba la phan thog 'byung bar ma zad zhi bde'i 'jig rten chen mo zhig bsgrun thub pa yang gdon mi za/da lta kho bos nan gyis bshad 'dod pa zhig ni/bod pa skya ser pho mo su yin kyang rang rgyud la byang chub sems ma skyes pa skyes bar byed pa dang /skyes pa mi nyam par byed pa/ma nyam pa gong 'phel du gtong rgyu/bcas ni kho bos snying thag pa nas re ba lan brgyar zhus pa yin/ /gnyis pa bud med kyi rin thang la do snang bya dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/ bod rigs bud med tsho'i 'das pa'i byung ba dang da lta'i gnas bab ma 'ong ba'i 'gyur ldog sogs gang la bsam kyang don 'di mi gleng ga med byung /gna' bo gdod ma'i spyi tshogs nas da lta'i dus rabs 'di la ma thon gyi bar du nga tsho skyes pa tsho'i bud med rnams la mthong chung dang dma' 'beb khyad gsod sogs byas pa bgrang gis mi lang /yin na yang da skabs dus rabs — 176 ——

nyer gcig pa'i gzhi dkyil la sleb yod pa'i nga tsho'i sngon ltar rnying ba lha srol du sgom pa'i rgan po skor zhig dang ma shes g.yam rgyug la dga' ba'i gsar bu kha shas kyi byed stang dang du blang te 'dug rkyang gang nas yin/spyir chos 'jig rten gang thad nas bshad na yang /bud med rnams med du mi rung bar ma zad skabs la lar da dong skyes pa las kyang lhag pa'i thun min gyi khyad chos mang du mchis/'on kyang sngon rabs spyi tshogs rnying ba'i lo rgyus yig cha 'ga' re dang / ge sar sgrung gtam ring mo sogs dpe deb kha shas su chung ma khyo bo'i gos steng la 'gom mi chog pa dang bud med dmag la zhugs skabs dman gras su brtsi ba skyes pa'i gong du bud med sdod mi rung ba rgyal khab dang khyim tshang gi bya ba gal chen la gsang gros byed skabs bud med kyis kha ya byed mi chog pa sogs bkod te gnas lugs med pa'i gom srol 'di lta bu rgyun chad ma myong / de bzhin du/da lta yang dgon par gnas pa'i bud med rab byung ba zhig la mtshon na grwa ba rab byung ba las dman pa dang / smad btsong ma'i skor la log g.yem byas rjes da dong lkog gsod byed pa/ mtho sgang gi yul gru na sbra nag gru bzhi dang cha med gnas yul la phug bsam bcol ba'i gnyom chung bu mo 'ga' zhig la rang dbang ci yang med pa/ sogs spyod ngan gyis skor 'di khyab rgya je cher 'gro bzhin 'dug de'i phyir nga tsho'i pho 'dzoms mo 'dzoms gyis lta ba gsar ba lag len byed dgos par ma zad gzhan don du rang srog kyang gtong phod pa'i ma yum drin mo che rnams la gong bkur dang drin gzo byed dgos/ da lta ngas 'di nas yang bskyar bshad 'dod pa zhig ni/ dus rabs gsar ba 'dir 'tshar long 'byong bzhin pa'i rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig mtho sgang yul gyi bu mo rnams dang smad btsong ma tsho'i las dbang la 'grel bshad rgyag par dga' bar ma zad 'phya smod byed rgyur de bas kyang dgarji/ pyi tsho'i

som dang khyod tsho'i las bya ni gzhan gyi bsgrub bzhin pa'i lam ngan de dor nas lam yang dag pa zhig la 'jug par skul slong byed rgyu de yin pa las gnyom chung bu mo 'ga' zhig gi bya ba bsgrubs skabs nor 'khrul cung tsam re yod pa la rgyang ring nas ltad mo lta zhor bla btsag dang 'phya smod byed rgyu de ga la yin/lhag par du da lta'i dus rabs 'dir kun dga' don 'aspub 'phrul gyis bu chung gi dbang shugs gang sar khyab bzhin pa'i sgang yin pa'i bu mo rnams kyis rang lus rtsed spyad byed pa 'di yang thabs med 'u bug gis bya ba zhig yin pa la sa don med du ku re rtse ba gtan nas min/gnas lugs ltar drang bshad byas na/ mtho ba gdugs zhabs dang khri thog na 'khor ba'i bla dpon man chad nas/ dma' ba mi ngo dang zas lhag la re ba'i sprang bo yan chad sger gnyer las don mi bsgrubs mkhan nyung shos yin/rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis kho tsho'i bya bar nor 'khrul yod pa'i cha rnams rtsom gyi brjod byar bkod te 'phya smod byed pa sogs rgyab tu bskyur nas kho tshor 'khrul med kyis mdun lam zhig btsal te rang mi rigs kyi gras su tshud thabs byed rgyu ni ches gal che ba'i bya ba yin/ ngas 'di ltar bshad pa yang rang gi drin ldan a ma rgan mo gtso byas pa'i gnyom chung bud med kha shas kyis las dbang la bsam gzhigs btang ba'i mjug 'bras kyis skad cha zhig yin pa kun gyis yid ches byed rogs/ mazug mthar bshad 'dod pa ni/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i dus bar 'dir bud med rab byung ba dang rgyu rtsal ba yon tan pa las byed pa sogs 'tshar long 'byung bzhin pa ni dga' 'os pa'i don bzang zhig yin mod 'on kyang log rtogs dug gis gajir ba'i mdo med 'phyon ma skor zhig gi gnas lugs ci yang ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyi ru mngon te rang nyid 'das log ma dang grub chen ma mkha' 'gro ma sogs yin par sgrog pa ni/gcig nas chos lugs la rmong — 178 —

cha bgo 'dod pa dang / skunyis nas mang tshogs la mgo skor btang ba yin ljaḍi hāṅgi ṭā / /trī shāgāt+na k+to ༵ dro/ bye /༵sna/ ma/ tshams 'jog rgyu ni kho bos gsum pa mjug bsdu ba'i gtam ni/ ra ba gang ri dkar bo'i bskor ba'i bsil ldan sman gyi yul gru 'dir 'tshar long byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi bod rigs pho mo rnams pa/ nga tsho'i dmigs yul dang la rgya ni mi rigs zhig gi bde sdug dang mes po gong ma'i lta ba yin/snga ma ltar na dmigs yul ni/mi rigs de'i bde sdug yin te nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i rjes lus kyis mtshang ming khur nas sdug bsngal gyi klongs su 'khyam skabs nga tsho'i dmigs yul 'grub med 'on kyang nam zhig nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i sngon thon gyis mtshan snyan 'khur bzhin bde skyid kyis zhing khams su 'byor skabs da gathod nga tsho'i dmigs yul 'grub tshar ba yin/ phyi ma ltar na/la rgya ni mes po gong ma'i lta ba yin te/nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i 'tshe med zhi ba chen mo'i lta ba rgyab tu dor gnod 'tshe bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rang rgyud kheng bzhin 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan dag gi gras su 'tshang thabs byas na nga tsho'i la rgya mong nas zhug tshar ba yin/ 'on kyang nam zhig nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i mes po gong ma'i lta ba dang len byas te dus rabs gsar ba'i bslab bya'i 'gros dang bstun nas 'dzam gling zhi ༵ṭī tāskyi sdo/'i/ dar cha mkha' la bsgrings thub na da gzod nga tsho'i la rgya zin

bla ma zhig la mjal du song ba'i tshor snang /spyi lo nyis stong tham pa'i lo'i zla drug tshes brgyad nyin nga gang 'gro bar 'dod pa'i dgon gnas der 'byor/ bod kyi kha dper yar klungs ri yi 'dabs rol nas//yar lha sham por gnas bstod dgos//zer ba ltar/nga yang dgon bdag bla mar mjal du song / thog mar gzim khang sgor 'byor skabs sham bha la rig ldan drag po'i zhing〉 zhes pa'i yig 'bri 'ga' mngon byung / ngas mi yul gyi bla ma tsho lkog gyur la 'di 'dra zhig /dga' ba 'am yang na 'di 'dra'i gus bkur byed don ci yin snyam bzhin sgo nang du 'dzul/che chung tshad dang ldan pa'i ra skor de ru rgyab kyi la ba'i kha dog dang nang gi bsam pa'i 'char sgo mi gcig pa'i mjal ba mang bo srin ltar 'thibs shing rlung ltar 'tshub 'dug/pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi rnam thar las/ded dpon nor bu bzang po'i lcag mkhar sgo med nang gi mi dag mthong nas ya mtshan pa ltar nga yang ngo ma ya mtshar song / de yang la la'i brkyangs phyag 'tshal zhor gsol ba grangs med 'debs shing skyid sdug yod tshad bla ma mkhyen zhes mgo bo smad de re skug byed/ la la nad kyi mnar zhing ngo gdong skya thag ger snang na yang lud pa 'phen zhor re sgug byed/ la la ltog skom gyi mnar te mchil ma mid zhor re sgug byed/ don dngos su kho tsho'i bla ma'i zhal mjal par re sgug byed pa ma yin nam/gnas tshul de dag mthong rjes nga yid skyo la khro sdang ba zhig tu gyur/ yin gcig min gnyis kho mjal dka' ba'i bla ma der mjal thabs byed dgos snyam skabs/ khyod bla mar mjal du shog ces bos byung bas ngas kyang nyin mo bde legs kyi mjal dar chung chung zhig lag tu thog nas bla ma'i mdun du phyin spag snang gis ge 180 ge

ded pa 'am gang ltar rgyu mtshan ci yin ma shes mod bsam dbang med par phyag 'ga' 'tshal te kham bde zhus/bod mi zhig yin phyin bla ma'i mdun du thog mar 'byor ma thag zhal ngo la zhib lta byed mi phod pa chos nyid zhis gam yang na bags chags shig yin yang srid/ de'i dbang gis ngas kyang thog mar khong gi zhal ngo la lta ma phod par maso bo smad de bsdad/ gsungs skad zhan pa'i bla ma'i gnas tshul mang bo zhig dris byung / skabs der ngas khong nyid kyi zhal la lta thub par gyur/e ma ho/da ni ngo ma 'chugs song ngas kho la phyag 'tshal ba 'chugs song ma gzhir kho ni rgan po zhig red/ sku stod dam khog stod la phyi rgyal gyi thon rdzas shig los yin snyam pa'i tshi len khra bo zhig mnab pa 'am gyon yod pa dang / sku smad dam khog smad la rkang snam sngon po sha 'byar ma zhig mnab pa 'am gyon 'dug/ pas so/ nga la tshor snang 'dra min sna tshogs skye skabs su bla ma yin par grags pa de'i slar yang spyod 'jug thos e myong /zhes dris byung /ngas myong /zhes lan btab ma thag/khong gis chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems yin don ci red ces gsungs ba dang / yang a la ku re yin/ khyod dpe char gzigs myong mkhan zhig yin par bshad kin 'dug phyir de 'dra zhig los shes gsungs/ ngas de 'dra zhig 'dri don ci yin snyam skabs bla rgan zhig thon te bla ma rin po che lags/ sman sbyin gtong tshod sleb byung zhes yar zhu byas/ bar der da ci ra skor du yod pa rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mjal dar 'bul du thon la bla ma mchog gis kho tshor sman dang sgor mo sogs grangs med pa du ma sbyin song bar ma zad zas gos 'ang mang bo zhig sbyin pa btang / da dung nang 'khor dge slong rgan pa zhig gis bshad pa ltar na/lo rer bdag cag gi sngon pa mtshungs ba med pa mnyam med zas gtsang sras po'i 'khrungs skar sogs dus chen gyi nyin mor rgyun du phyogs so sor pheb ste srog ldan gyi — 181 —

skye 'gro khri 'bum mang bo srog nyen las skyob pa'i mdzad pa skyong bzhin 'dug zer/ mthong thos de dag la rkyen byas te rang nyid kyi de sngon khong la de 'dra'i lta tshul zhig bcang ba'i cha la rnang 'aspyod dang / da lta mig mdun du lhag pa'i skyes bu 'di ni phyi smyon pa'i bdag nyid can dang / nang snying rje'i snying bo can zhig yin pa'i nges shes gnyis rgyud la cig char du skyes so//

blog brnyan grags can mang bo mthong ba dang chabs cig ngu byung ba'i tshor snang brjod pa/de yang go bdun lo'i lo stod tsam nas bzung bdag gis skad sbyor ba rnams kyis bsgyur bsgrun byas zin pa'i bod skad kyi glog brnyan grags can mang bor khom skabs kyi chu tshod bed spyad de zhib lta thengs gang mang la byas pa yin/ des na de dag gi bdag la byin pa'i tshor snang ni sna tshogs pa zhig ste de yang dper na chu ngogs gtam rgyud〉ces pa'i glog brnyan de las sung rgyal rabs kyi skabs su byung myong ba'i dmangs khrod kyi dpa' rgod tsho'i drang bden gyi rang gshis dang gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam phu nu so so'i bar gyi brtse dung dmigs yul dang bgrod phyogs tha dad yin pa'i las dbang sogs gsal bor mthong thub/ gzhan da dung sung rgyal khab kyi gong ma chen mo'i gzi nyams dang kho'i mnga' log na gnas pa'i blon chen dang dmag spyi 'ga'i ngo tsha khrel med kyi spyod ngan skabs de'i mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs rngam bajid ldan pa'i gong ma'i pho brang dang de'i khor yug mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i leng hran mtsho gling dang de'i khor yus ming du grags pa'i rgya nag gi dgon sde 'ga' dang de dag gi khor yug sogs ma lus par mthong thub bo/de'i rkyen gyis gna' bo'i khor yug gi rnam pa dang dpa' bo tsho'i rang gshis sogs kyis bdag la dga' ba'i tshor snang dang sgyud lugs che ba'i gong ma dang ngan gshis che ba'i blon tshogs kyi snang brnyan sogs kyis bdag la sdang ba'i tshor snang sogs byin/ gzhakā ḍi dze+eng

rtsal dpon dase rgan lin khrung khyim dang chung ma sogs la kha 'bral skabs kyi rnam pa dang pho rgod lu khu'e'i a ma rgya stag gis zos rjes kyi gnas bab ri steng mkhar rdzong gi gtso dpon gra'o ka'e phu nu tshor 'bral kha'i rnam pa leng hran mtsho gling gi dpa' bo'i tshogs pa kha thor dgu thor du song ba'i gnas tshul sogs kyis bdag la skyo ba'i tshor snang byin no/ gzhan zla med glo gri〉zhes pa'i glog brnyan de las bye thang gi dpa' rgod 'ga'i snang brnyan dang ham sems ldan pa'i rgyal blon 'ga'i lta spyod brtse dung che ba'i mdzes ma 'ga'i gshis spyod drag rtsal ldan pa'i mi ngan 'ga'i sbyor tsub skabs de'i khor yug gi rnam pa sogs gsal bor mthong thub/ de'i rkyen gyis drag rtsal mkhan po glog zhags 'od 'bar dang khri ba chen mo mkhyen rab sogs kyi rang gshis dang ngo mtshar ba'i mthu rtsal gyis bdag la dga' ba'i tshor snang dang / gong ma'i rgyal sa g.yo 'phrog byed sems ldan mkhan blon chen bang hong dang khul dpon chen mo'i go sar rngam mkhan de'i bu chung gnyis kyi ngan gshis dang ham sems sogs kyis bdag la sdang ba'i tshor snang 'gyur med kyi brtse dung rgyud la 'chang mkhan bu mo ho me dang me nyang gnyis kyi gnas tshul gyis bdag la skyo ba'i tshor snang gdug rtsub che ba'i thog med ral gri dang bye rlung 'tshub ma gnyis kyi drag rtsal dang ngan spyod bcas kyis bdag la dga' sdang gnyis ldan gyi tshor snang sogs byin no/ da dung lhad med kyi brtse dung〉zhes pa'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos gtsor byas te 'khrab yod pa'i glog brnyan de las las dbang dang bgrod phyogs go gnas bcas mi gcig pa'i mi sna mang bo'i gnas tshul dang deng rabs kyi khyad chos 'bur thon can gyi grong khyer gyi snang brnyan sogs gsal bor mthong thub/de'i rkyen gyis gtam rgyud 'di'i mi sna gtso gras zhang kang gi skyin bdag chen mo ja khrin gyi mi tshe'i gnas tshul gyis bdag la dga' sdang skyo gsum gyi — 184 —

tshor snang dang / chung dus nas gar song cha med du gyur ba'i kho'i bu chung gi gshis spyod dang / bu mo'i gshis spyod sogs kyis bdag la dga' sdang gnyis kyi tshor snang /zhing rung dang mes cho gnyis kyi gshis spyod kyis bdag la dga' snang gnyis kyi tshor snang sogs mdor na mi sna gtso bo re re'i bdag la sna mi 'dra ba'i tshor snang re re byin no/ de bzhin du klu mo dkar mo'i lha sgrung〉dang mnga' bdag rgyal bo'i gnas tshul〉 nub bskyod zin tho〉 lha srin sde brgyad〉 me stog bcos ma〉 jing gir rgyal bo〉 le'u drun mchod rten〉 tshang du yib pa'i stag 'brug〉 ci 'dra'i mtshar sdugs ldan pa la〉 ma yong krin〉 gri thog pa〉 me rtog pho brang〉 bden rdzun brdar sha chod pa〉 dar mdo'i mdza' gzhas〉 nyen rtog pa'i mtshan snyan〉 cham phab〉sogs glog brnyan dag las skabs kyi mi sna gtso bo dang yul ljongs sna tshogs gshis spyod dang las dbang sogs mi gcig pa'i tshul sogs so sor gsal bor mthong thub/ de'i rkyen gyis klu mo dkar mo bza' zla gnyis kha bral du btang ba'i skyo gar gyis skyo ba'i tshor snang dang /mnga' bdag gi gshis spyod dang btsun mo chen mo'i brtan sems blon chen rnams kyi blo rgya mnga' 'bang rnams kyi gnas tshul sogs kyis bdag la dga' snang mtshar skyo bzhi'i tshor snang / thang san bla ma'i spyod tshul dang sprel mgo can gyi mthu rtsal phag mgo can gyi 'dod sems dge spun gsum pa'i drang spyod sogs kyis bdag la dga' spro'i tshor snang / dpa' rgod spun gsum gyi gshis spyod dang las dbang brtse dung sogs kyis bdag la dga' skyo gnyis kyi tshor snang / chung ma'i khyo bo bsad pa'i gnas tshul las 'phros te ma bu gsum gyi bar du byung ba'i don rkyen gyis bdag la skyo ba'i tshor snang / sog rgyal chen mo'i dpa' nyams dang / kho chung dus kyi gnas tshul sog po'i dpa' rtul rnams kyi rang gshis dang dpa' spyod ming du grags pa'i rgyal khab 'ga' — 185 —

la pham nyes byung ba'i lo rgyus rgyal khab de dag gi dpa' rgod 'ga'i snang brnyan sogs kyis bdag la dga' mtshar skyo gsum gyi tshor snang / dpa' rgod zhig dang bu mo zhig gi gshis spyod dang brtse dung mi ngan 'ga'i sbyor tsub sogs kyis bdag la dga' skyo sdang gsum gyi tshor snang / blo brtan 'gyur med kyi dpa' sgod pho mo 'ga'i brtse dung dang gathis spyod drag rtsal las dbang sogs kyis bdag la skyo dga' gnyis kyi tshor snang / gsar brje mi sna'i blo dkar gzhung drang gi spyod tshul dang thams cad dmangs dang rgyal khab kyi ched du 'bul ba'i chod sems sogs kyis bdag la dga' skyo gnyis kyi tshor snang / drang bden skyong mkhan gyi po rgod ma yong krin gyi gshis spyod dang las dbang ngan dgu tshang ba'i sbyin bdag chen mo'i ngan gshis dang / ma bu bo mo 'ga'i brtsenang sogs kyis bdag la dga' sdang skyo gsum gyi tshor snang / dpa' rgod gri thog pa zhig gi drag rtsal dang rang gshis brtse dung mi ngan 'ga'i rgyub sems sogs kyis/ bdag la dga' skyo sdang gsum gyi tshor snang / drag rtsal la dbang 'byor ba'i pho mo 'ga'i brtse dung dang gshis sbyod las dbang khyim chen zhig kha thor du song ba'i ya nga ba'i gnas tshul mi ngan pha bu gnyis kyi gshis sbyor sogs kyis bdag la skyo 'jigs snang gsum gyi tshor snang / spyi tshogs sring ba'i dus kyi bod dpon zhig gi gshis spyod dang kho'i gache chung gnyis kyi gshis rgyud dang bsam blo spyod tshul yid brtan med pa'i bod rigs bu r+sha'aga'i spyod tshul sogs kyis bdag la sdang mtshar sdang gsum gyi tshor snang / dar mdo'i sku drag mchod rten gyi gshis spyod dang bu mo mkha' 'gro'i gshis rgyud dang brtse dung pho rgod blo bzang gi gshis spyod bde skyid sku drag gi ngan sbyor sogs kyis bdag la dga' skyo sdang ba'i tshor snang / nyen dpon dam pa'i gshis spyod dang blo rig yod tshad gzhan la gul ba'i nyen dpon gzhan zhig gi — 186 —

gshis rgyud ngan dgu tshang ba'i mi ngan skor zhig gi spobs pa dang gshis spyod sogs kyis bdag la dga' mtshar skyo sdang bzhi'i tshor snang stobs shugs dang nus pa che ba'i jag dpon zhig gi rang gshis dang gzi nyams kho'i mnga' 'og gi spun zla 'ga'i nus rtsal dang gshis spyod bla na med pa'i nyen dpon zhig gi blo gros sogs kyis bdag la mtshar sdang dga' gsum gyi tshor snang sogs byin no/ /red ya 'di dag ni ngas glog brnyan dag mthong rjes kyi tshor snang yin la bla na med pa'i mi tshe'i khrod kyi tshor snang shā/ trī ṭ+wāṃ tāg// kyang yin/ mthar nga la bshad rgyu gzhan gang yang med pas — 187 —

mjug zhungs /k+tad ma dṛ/da rna zlo trī ༵ py-i kā dī/rjod thub song / da lta bdag la mkho ba ni lkog nas ngan smra re byed zhor ngo bstod kyi 'ug pa dgod pa'i blun po'i rnam thar de ma yin par zhi bde dang 'dra mnyam gyi sgo nas phan tshun la bsam 'char sna tshogs sged pa med par brjod rgyu de yin de'i phyir ngas bshad pa yod tshad chags sdang gis kun rtogs dkris shing blang dor gyi blo mig dben pa'i glen nag tshor 'brel ba ci yang med la yod mi srid dge chos rin po che'i tshad ma'i skyes bu med par gsung ba ltar/ tshad min gyi blo la tshad med pa'i nor 'khrul 'byung ba yang 'jig rten khams 'di'i chos nyid las ma 'das phyir bar 'dir snying thag pa nas mthol bshags bgyis pa yin mthar ngo mi shes pa'i tsho ma 'ong bar yang 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i dpe deb dag brgyud nas phan tshun la rgyus lon byed thub nges yin pa'i bde mo byos//zhes rtsom pa pos rang shag nas bris so//kho bos bris rtsom 'di dag gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ni/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rigs gter dang de'i rang 'grel klong chen pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i de kho nyid bsdus pa/ lo tsā ba chen pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam nges kyi dka' gnas rnams par bshad pa/ klo bo mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa'i rigs lam gsal ba'i nyi ma rigs gter gyi phyogs snga rnam pasdu sdushad pa rigs lam gsal byed/ rigs gter la nye bar mkho ba

mtha' gnyis gsal byed/go rams mdzad pa'i rigs gter gyi don gsal bar byed pa/ ra stod pa bsod nams dbang rgyal gis mdzad pa'i bsdus gzhung legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ bse ngag dbang bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i bse bsdus grwa/ a khu dmu dge bsam gtan gyis mdzad pa'i blo gsal rigs sgo/ mkhan chen gzhan dgas mdzad pa'i dbu ma la 'jug pa'i mchan 'grel/ mi pham pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma rgyan gyi rnam bshad 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i zhal lung dbu ma nges sgron mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ yul nang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis bsgyur ba'i phyi rgyal gyi tshad ma rigs pa'i zhib 'jug/mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i sde bdun rgyan yid kyi mun sel/rje dge 'dun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rigs rgyan/ rgyal tshab rjes mdzad pa'i rigs thigs kyi 'grel ba legs bshad snying bo'i gter/ dge bshes sbyin pa rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rigs lam dpag bsam me tog /'ba' lang dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i rigs lam thor bu'i rnam bzhag blo gsal ngang mo 'gug pa'i legs bshad pad+mo'i mtsho chen/'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i yig cha kun bzang zhing gi nyi ma/ rnal 'byor ba rus rgyan can gyis mdzad pa'i rje mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur/gzungs bsdus na 'khod yod pa'i bgres mo'i zhus pa'i mdo/ ko shi ka'i bshags mdo/ rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bos mdzad pa'i grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba/ pad+ma bka' thang chen rmo/ thar ba chen po'i mdo/'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde dbang gi rgyal bo/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i klu sgrub dgongs rgyan/'dod pa'i bltan bcos/ bya mdo don grub tshe ring gis bsgrigs pa'i mkhas pa brgyad kyi zhal gdam/ thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun du bzang bos smon lam/ dbus za mkha' —— 189 —

'gro mas mdzad pa'i rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi zin bris dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal rgyun nag 'gros su bkod pa tshig don rab gsal skal ldan dgyes pa'i mgul rgyan/ rje zhabs dkar bas mdzad pa'i 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i glu dbyangs sa lam ma lus myur du mgroṭ+wāṃ byed rtsasdu ldanamakha' ṭīng gaṭ+wāṃgasarlabs/ dung ṭā// rdo me+eṭ+wāṃdro ṭ+wāṃ// na las —sa mdzad pa— chos da zung 'brel skor

mi rkyang gi don gtam/khyim pa'i bsam par grwa ba bag yang snyam//grwa ba'i blo ngor khyim pa khrims bral bsam//mi mthun blo yi gzhal ba'i khor yug 'dir//mthun pa'i snang ba gcig du 'grub par dka'//pho mo phan tshun dga' ba mi yi gshis//grwa ba rnams kyang sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i//'dzam gling mi rigs thams cad 'dra 'dra yin//mi la mi gshis ldan min su yis rtsod//mngar cha kun gyi yang rtse rgun 'brum bcud//bde ba rnams kyi ca/chog gyur sman shar drod//khyed cag khyim pa rnams pa'i nang rol na//'di nyid spong mkhan skye bo ji tsam mchis//rab byung ban de chung ngu'i pha ma 'ga'i//grwa ba'i chang sogs 'thung ba than yin zer//sha khrag za 'thung phyir gyi lugs srol tsam//'di yi khyad par ston pa'i ma mkhyen nam//

thub pa'i rang sga lus la dpe long gsungs//'di nyid gzhan phan bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro yin//'dod pa'i khams nas 'dod pa spyod pa tsam//rang gzhan gnyis kar phan pa'i bshad par dka'//grwa ba'i mi khar 'jigs nas khrims zhig srung //khyim pa'i de la dpyad nas skyon zhig btsal//don la nor 'khrul su la'ang yod srid pa'i//rang rang sa nas btsan mkhar bzung na dga'//rig gsar mkhan po dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis//'jig rten 'di na tshad ma dkon par bshad//bod pa khri 'bum blo ngor bden tsam gyis//de nyid nor 'khrul min pa'i nges pa bral//deng rashās slobachewa'agritrīṭ+wāṃ'islob ma'agatrī//mai kā shā byetā ṭār+shak+ṇiṅge kā kāske garte lhazu//sa/ su ma nga //byang chub sems dpa' 'ang mang bas gzab gzab kyis//lo ngo nyi shur son pa'i mo gzhon 'ga'//bla dpon bgres po rnams la dga' srid na//phoyirigasastaskyesapa'igrwagasaraṭ+wāṃ/tsha// /spraṅgi ñcha sebyes dak+taṭ+wāṃ ༵ kā trīṭā bye sdo ṭā////grwa ba'i sems pa mi yi sems yin pas//mi dang dud 'gro'i khyad par 'di kho nas//— 1༵2 tsho mi rkyang sems pa mi rtogs sam//

'dukā bshā don ṭ+wāṃkā rang lurnyi btsoshā du bcug/shāṭ+wāṃ byek+ṇi byekā kāsdo tretrīkā trī sdo sta ༵ra////dge sbyong marga nag tshogs rnams snying re rje//bla dpon btsan po rnams kyis dmod kyang 'dra//don med mang tshogs tsho yi smad kyang rung //sems su shar ba yi ger bkod pa 'di//mi rkyang zhig gi zung khrag dron po yin//nyis stong bzhi lo'i zla dang por pha yul du//

sems khur gyi 'o dodabarjid chen bla ma'i mjal kha sgor gyis zhu//dbang chen dpon po'i ltag sgo sgor gyis phye//mi yu la sgor gyis dkrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas//sgor med sprang bo'i khyu rnams gang la 'gro//chu len g.yog mo'i skyo gzhas ri la khyab//phyug rdzi rgan po'i ngan skad lhas na grags//gces phrug gcer bu'i ngu sgra khyim du 'khor// thabs sdug rigs 'di'i 'tsho tshul de tsam blogs//mtho sgang rdza ri'i gam na phyug rdzi stong //smad phyogs mkhaṭ+wāṃ groṭ+wāṃ 'dabadī su zhing ba khri//ṭā r+shasna zlokā ṭ+wāṃ rte trī ṅge dā ṭānā bye 'a//bum//bco brgyad bu mo'i mi tshe gnas nas zad//nyi shu bu pho'i mdun lam ri nas tshar//mdang skyes phru gu'i phugs don gzhan la bcol//bod 'brog phal che'i 'gro stang 'di 'drar snang //kun kha mthun pa kun gyis bden par 'dzin//gsar bshad lta bar dmod pa'i mchil zhag 'phen//'dre dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogs sngar bzhin rgyas//glen dang rmongs ba'i bya la sa de ltar dar//nyis stongabazhi lo'i zla lnga bar pha yul du//— 19snye —

snying chung gi 'phar sgraskya ka khra chung mgron gyi pho nyar ji//kha ta nag chung bdud kyi 'phrul byar bsgoms//snyig ma lnga bdo'i mi yi rnam rtog 'di//kha lo bsgyur mkhan sangs rgyas su zhig mchis//a pha nad kyis zin dus gto zhig 'phangs//a ma gdon gyis theb zer mo la bsten//a mchod 'khyams po zhig la gto yon gcis//a lags bajid po zhig la mo yon gnyis//gzhis byes 'gro 'dug kha phyogs lung la bcol//dgra jag rkun gsum byung dus bsang re phul//ri mgo mthon po gzhi bdag gnyan por 'bod//lab rtse brjid po dgra bla'i mkhar du 'dzin//mtshan mo 'dre srin rang gzugs ngom par 'jigs//dus rgyun lha 'khrug klu banol byed par skrag/mtho sgang yul na gnas pa'i rong 'brog rnams//sems chung kho na'i ngang du mi tshe 'da'//'dre yi mi sha za zhes dmod mo byed//spyang ki'i lug sha za zhes than du rtsi//nga tsho'i nor lug khri 'bum gsod pa la//mi 'dre mjug med spyang skar cis mi 'bod—// 195 ——

sku lo sku phreng mang na bla chen dang //dpon po 'byor ba ldan na dpon chen brjod//mes po gong ma'i bslab pa'i srol ngan 'di//༵ kā' gatrīt+na ༵nga ṅgi /ra nga sgru sdis gi bsdo/// du rtsi//mo rtsis lha 'beb gna' rabs bon po'i lugs//: kā r+sha/ ṭ+wāṃ kā ñcā ༵ṭā sgrisdo rdzu ldatrī sro//la//bla ma'i ci mdzad bden pa'i dag snang dang //grwa ba'i ci byas rdzun pa'i mthong snang gnyis//'dra dang mi 'dra gnas lugs mig gis lta//gzhan du bden rdzun tshad ma'i shan 'byed dka'//mdor na 'di 'dra'i gnas lugs mang mchis mod//go rtogs dman pa 'ga' la phan lhad du//don gyi gnad gseng kha shas zhib du btsal//tshig gi sbyor ba 'ga' zhig btsan gyis bsgrigs//nga tsho'i lam lugs yun du gnas pa dang //blo mnyam grogs 'ga'i bzhed pa mthar phyin phyir//lho phyogs 'chi bdag pho nyas ma zin bar//stsa gu thang la mi 'phen dam bca' byed//nyis stong drug lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer drug par pha yul du//— 196 —

sems pa rmas ma'i bden ngon gyi gsang bakha 'don dbyangs rta ngag la gyer bas gna' mi rnying ba'i dad sems mngon//bsang khri skya bor dud pa 'khor nas lha 'dre'i gson shugs sngar bzhin rgyas//mgo sbra skug po rlung gi bskyod phyir rgan byis gcer bu'i grang 'dar thos//yug mo khri yis ngu sgra sgyur bo rma chen gangs ri'i dbu la 'khor//gser dngul rin bral gzhan gyis 'phrog pas bse 'gong shi bo'i gom kha 'gran//phyug po'i bde skyid lha la byin pas sha khrig dmar gyis ri mtshor grub//mtho sgang rdza ri'i kha char bu yug rong 'brog dbul bo'i steng du 'tshub//khrig gi bzos pa'i phu nu'i nang dme a pha a ma'i snying la thebs//a lags bde ldan zhing nas pheb ste 'gro don mdzad pa'i rnam thar gleng //a khu mtho sgang ri la byin nas 'brong rgod btul ba'i lo rgyus bsgrags//a pha lha yi bka' chad phog nas tshe las 'das pa'i gnas tshul bshad//a ma btsan gyis dug grub byung nas rkang lag zha ba'i rgyu mtshan smras//dgon pa gshin gson dkor gyis brgyan te mdzod khang the'u rang glud du phul//sde ba gong ma'i khrims kyis mnan te khral dngul 'byung bo'i tshogs su bskor//khyim tshang lha mo rtsis gsum byas te nor lha'i mgo grangs rim gyis stong //bu mor bla ma'i lung zhig bstan te drang bden gnyen bsu 'asnyor ba'i khyer//pham nyes nag po'i gdug rgyub 'khor ba'i grangs nyung mi rigs rlung rta rgud//skyo gdung drag po'i dngan pa ring mo las dbang dkar bo'i gseb tu lharga/chos srol khrims srol sna tshogs khrod nas mi gzhon du ma'itshe srog zad//tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yi gtong mkhan bya btang rtsags rnams dmyal bar sprang 1//97 —

'jig rten gsang ba phyi ru brtol mkhas mkhas pa'i snyan grags chu la btab//rang gi bde sdug rgyab tu 'dor mkhas mkhas pa'i dbang cha rtsad nas 'asdog/bod mi'i la rgya drang mor 'dzin mkhas mkhas pa'i tshe srog ming nas gtub//shes bya'i don rnams ma lus mkhyen mkhas mkhas pa'i yon tan gzhan gyis khyer//rang gzhan kun gyis bsam blo gtong phyir skad gsang thon po'i re ba bton//mi rigs shig gi las don 'grub ched sa sgyug zad por mi tshe bcol//snyan ngag ma// //di///shoranas tshig nyog lung ba gdī tsam bris//sprashā trī shā ṭā ṅgeṭā ṭāk+ṇi /༵ ༵tā ༵kā sdurdo ra//nga sa nas chams 'dug/

snying dkyil nas thon pa'i zug ju/sa bcu lam lnga'i rtogs pa med pa dang //gzhung brgya'i 'khrul ba cig char ma chod phyir//deng rabs lo nyung btsun pa chung chung tshor//rnam rtog 'gyur ldog yod pa chos nyid yin//mi la lha yi mdzad pa yod srid na//grwa ba'i spyod pa'ang mdzad par bajis pa'i chog/mi yi tshad gzhi sngar bzhin mi yin na//bla sprul rnams kyang mi las 'da' sa med//rgya gar ston pa'i bka' chos mi la gsung //mes po grub pa thob nas 'phur rab bshad //nga tsho yid smon skyes nas lad mo byas//zlos gar chung chung 'di nyid rdzogs mtha' med//'ja' lus chos sku zhes pa ming stong min//mdo sngag zung 'brel bya ba rtsed chas min//'on kyang mi chos dar ba'i 'jig rten 'dir//nga tsho'i ci ltar 'bad kyang thar ba dka'//grwa gzhon lo nyung mgo na ra co med//khri thog bla sprul dbu na 'od gor med//khyad par bzang ngan spyod pa'i 'byed dgos na//bod kyis yul na sdom ldan nyung nyung yin//— 199 —

dzāji sogs shes bya kāl cher grwa ༵'i rtogs//sdoṅge k+ta ༈༵ sna trīsna ṭ+wāṃk+ta r+sha sna / gatrem ṭāsna pa////rigs pa smra ba'i sems na gsal ler yod//chos skyong srung ma'i lha dpung khyed la myur//py-igālhasam shākā kānā ༵gāgazlo zlo/ṭ+wāṃ /tā dzo/da/ d+ku nus//chos srid dbang bsgyur gser khrir khyed cag 'dzegs//r+sha// me+esnazlo baṃ shāsnanab /rjodig patrīng kha 'a /rda//'i tshul//dpon po'i ṭ+wāṃ bu sprangadī bu rang ṭ+wāṃbar detrī//ṭ+wāṃ/ smusu~Xzhi rte spra~X ṭī~Xsdudro ༵ ༵sa dupa// da //— 200 —

sems las brdol ba'i na zug gi glu chung /sprel dang brag srin 'dus pa'i sbyor ba las//zla med bod pa bye ba'i rnam thar byung //phu nu'i nang dme byas pa'i skyo gar la//spobs pa'i glu zhig long dang na mnyam tsho//dbang shugs kho na'i 'tsho ba'i bla sprul 'gas//mang tshogs zas su za ba'i lo rgyus dang //dpal 'byor yong sgo mtho ba'i rnam thar la//spobs pa'i glu zhig long dang na mnyam tsho//lha klu skyabs gnas bsgom pa'i sems ldan 'gas//mgo bo gnam la gtad pa'i nor 'khrul dang //skyid sdug gzhan la re ba'i lam lugs la//spobs pa'i glu zhig long dang na mnyam tsho//gnas lugs ci yang mi shes blun po 'gas//ral ba 'dom gang yod pa'i gzugs brnyan dang //grub chen cha lugs ngom pa'i byed phyogs la//spobs pa'i glu zhig long dang na mnyam tsho//rang dbang mtho gang med pa'i bu mo 'gas//gzhan yul mig chu'i bsnyegs pa'i 'gro lugs dang //brtse dung btsan gyis gtor ba'i las dbang la//spobs pa'i glu zhig long dang na mnyam tsho//

sems can ma ru mthong ba'i chos pa 'gas//nyam thag srog blu gyed pa'i mdzad bzang dang //byang chub sems mchog mnga' ba'i thugs rgyud la//spobs pa'i glu zhig longs dang na mnyam tsho//ma rtsa dahāl sgokā mang ṭ+wā'i tshong dpon 'gas//ñcha ṭīsnaṭ+wāṃ py-i/ du ṭā snatre dṛspra sbyaṭākā da//nga //spobs pa'i glu zhig long dang na mnyam tsho//zhing phyugs las la goms pa'i rong 'brog 'gas//bu phrug g.yog du bkol ba'i kha phyogs dang //rig gnas rtsa ltar 'dor ba'i glen rtags la//spobs pa'i glu zhig longs dang na mnyam tsho//glu zhig leṭ+wāṃ 'dotā spobs sem/ mochis mod kyang //sdokā rnyigan rted 'a kābye rnyi shā rnyi sdo sdoṭā dṛ /tā////bzlog med las kyis ded pa'i glu 'di thal//bla dpon btsan po rnams kyis sku bzur zhig/rong 'brog pho mo kun gyis mgo sgur zhig/na mnyam spun zla rnams kyis grogs mdzod cig/nor 'khrul yod na gnas lugs can la bshags//nyis stong gsum lo'i zla bcu bar pha yul du//— 202 —

pha yul la phul ba/mngal sgo dog mo zhig gi na zug brgyud//masga nag mi gral 'di ru 'tshar long byung //pha ma gnyis 'dzom min pa'i dwa phrug nga //'jig rten skum po 'di nas 'khor thabs byas//sha khrag 'o thung bya bar 'bad pa sogs//spyir gyi srog ldan zhig gi rang gshis tsam//nga tsho srog ldan nang nas mi yin pa'i//dud 'gro sogs las khyad par 'phags pa dgos//phyi rgyal nang rgyal gnyis la rig gnas dar//si khron a mdo sogs su rig gnas dar//'dzam gling yul gru kun la rig gnas dar//nga tsho gcig pu thar sa gang nas gda'//dge ba bsgrubs na lha 'bod klu 'bod byed//skyabs su re na mo jis lung gsum mchog/pha mes dang po'i srol ngan 'di tsho yang //dor na mi rung gnas lugs su yi bshad//bla ma yin na chos srid gnyis ldan zhig/sprul sku yin na gong ma'i rnam shes zhig/ci yang min na gra rkyang drang mo zhig/'di ni bod ma'i mtshon byed dang po yin//rnga srub rol cha 'dzin lugs shes tsam dang— // 203 d+ngha

kha ton dpe cha'i mgo rnga rtolas tsam gyis//ban de bzang bo'i gras su rtsi chog na//grwa sar dka' spyad byed pa'i dgos pa ci//byis pa thams cad rgya rigs slob grar 'grim//shul las pha ma rnams kyis re 'dun bcol//slob dpon thon mis bzos pa'i bod yig la//rin thang med pa su la go rtogs skyes//'ja' tshon ri mo bkra bar ltas bzang brjod//rlung nag 'tshub ma byung bar ltas ngan smra//nga tsho rigs 'di'i klad pa'i go rtogs la//shes rig ci tsam ldan pa 'di nas go//khyed tsho'i dmod mo gang yod nga la byos//nga yi sems gtam yod tshad khyed tshor brjod//nga dang khyed tsho'i bar na sha 'khon zhig/sha 'khon de yang bsam na snying nad zhig/de ring 'di tsam ma gtog khom ma byung //swādītram̐kās ༵ ṭ+wāṃspyakā r+shasdi zidopro ljo sems yod//rdo ṅgetrī ṭ+wāṃ di ༵༵ hūṃkhro ṅgedī rdo je rdzu////nyis stong gsum lo'i zla bcu bar pha yul du//

skyo glukhyim bdag sgan po'i bka' dbang btsan po rgyud 'dzin tsha bo'i gnya' la bab//nyam chung dud 'gro'i sug bzhi bcang nas srog rtsa dmar bo dum bur satub//'tshe med zhi bde'i gnas mchos 'di la khrag gis brdzis pa'i gtam rgyud 'khyil//'byor med mi rkyang 'khyam po'i mig la 'jigs su rung ba'i ltad mo shar//ma byed ma byed skyur zhog zer rgyu lo rgan brgyad cu'i a mar ltos//red do red do 'gris 'dug zer rgyu lug chung dkar bo'i nyam la ltos//rgyu ma'i nang mtshang phyi ru mngon pa'i 'das ma 'das kyis so mtshams 'dir//so so'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba yis gzhan phan spyod bzang ji ltar bsgrub//yul mir ci khag sngon ma'i dus nas da lta'i bar du sha za mkhan//nga la ci khal sgyu gu bzung nas bden don 'tshol ba'i zhib 'jug mkhan//dud 'gror ci khag srog rtsa gnyom po gzhan la thor ba'i sdug shi mkhan//mdor na 'di la ci zhis byed dgos gnam rgan sngon mo zhar sgo ga ma//sha khrag la rngam mi sprig spyon pa'i gdong dmar srin po'i khyu tshogs rnams//'dasapa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis ma thul da lta'i las dbang 'di 'dra ba//nu/ 'ongs me tos tshom bu gcig du mnyam sangs rgya ba'i smon pa yang //rin chen byang chubasems mchog med na ji ltar 'grub thub glen pa 'i rigs //sha khyas spang nas mi tshe rgacig la tshangs bar spyod pa'i dge bsnyen ma//'di ltar bsam na drin ldan a ma las ming canayang byang sems dngos /rgyu dang 'bras bumi bslu'i rim pa thub pa'idabang bos zhal nas gsung //dadaranag go ldorga 'byung ba mi srid yid ches bskyed dgos brtse 2na ma// — 205 ——

nyam thag sems can srog bslu byed mkhan mkhan chen tshul khrim blo gros ste//spyan ras ga//sa ma/na dngos / byon ṭ+wāṃng py-igro ṭ+wāṃn 'di 'dra mong ba dka'//ṭā ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ṅgi ṭ+wāṃṭādro ༵/ sbya kā ṭ+wāṃsdosna / skyeṭ+wāṃ ma ༵nab dartebla pa ṭ+wāṃ nārār+sha/ /par ltos//'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul na thabs kyis 'gying ba'i gangs can mgon//gdul bya'i lhag ma gnyom ldan sems can khri tsho 'bum gyis las dbang la//rtag du ṭ+wāṃgs ṭ+wāṃ'i spyan gyis /zigs spyag bod ma'i semar+sha kyis nyi ma mardog/rteṭ+wāṃspya ṭ+wāṃng r+sha ṭ+wāṃtre ṭāṭ+wāṃ kā shā ṭ+wāṃd ༵trī swā ༵shā ṭ+wāṃb//sa phobs ga byams pa ga ra// — 206 da

gangs ri'i hā ༵༵ kau gcig la rlab chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//sngon byon mes po'i thugs bzhed 'argyub ched dang //'tsho ba'i rig gnas dar spel bya phyir du//bod mi'i la rgya skyong bzhin pheb la shog/rlabs chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//rang re'i mi rigs sngon du thon ched dang //rjes lus snang tshul 'jom par bya phyir du//dgag sgrub dogs gcod byed bzhin phebs la shog/rlabs chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//ro lang sde la 'gran ya slong ched dang //'jigs rung 'phrang nas thar bar bya phyir du//nga rgyal ku co sgrog bzhin pheb la shog/rlabs chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//da lta 'dir yod ming sring skyob ched dang //ma 'ongs phru gu bskyed bsring bya phyir du//ku bswo rmu rgyal 'then bzhin phebs la shog/rlabs chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//'tsho ba don snying can zhig rol ched dang //phyi gnas tshan rtsal nang 'dren bya phyir pyi// 207 —

shes rigs slo ba sbyong byed bzhin phebs la thos/rlabs chen sangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//pha skad gtsang ma'i sgra rgyun skyong ched dang //mkhas mchog thon mir rjes dran bya phyir du//rigs gzhung bod deb spel bzhin phebs la thos/rlabs chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//mes po'i gong ma'i goms srol 'dzin phyir dang //pho brang ta la'i gzi mdangs ngoms phyir du//tshan rtsal rig gnas gleng bzhin phebs la shog/rlabs chen gangs ri'i bu rgod dam pa tsho//phargan spre'u'i gaṭ+wāṃs bzang ngoms rtes dang //ṭāsbya~X trī / kā rnyirī dī ṅgi k+ṣiṃ kāsna/ trī ṭī bye sdu //ga//nyis stong bzhi lo'i zla brgyad par pha yu la du//

zi ling bod mi'i khrom gyis snang tshulatshong zong sna kha mang po thang mar brdal //rlangs 'khor che chung mang po ltar phreng bsgrigs//khang brtsegs mtho dma' mang po ri ltar brjid//grangs med mi rigs mang po sprin ltar 'thib//'byor ldan tshong ba'i 'di nas mgo skor gtong //dad ldan mjal ba'i 'di nas ngal gso byed//mkhyen ldan bla ma'i 'di nas lung bstan gsung //stobs ldan jag pa'i 'di nas dbang bsgyur mdzad//kha yag ngo dga' bshad mkhan sprang bo mod//khu tshur lcag skor g.yug mkhan rkun ma mod//dpang yig rdzun ma bsgrags mkhan grwa ba mod//'o 'dzin bla sha ston mkhan bud med mod//rgyal khrims mgo rnga med pa khrom 'di'i rgyan//rdung res 'khon res byed pa srang 'di'i srol//rku 'phrog mnar gcod gtong ba sde 'di'i 'u sas//mi rigs la rgya dben pa yul 'di'i chos/bod mi'i khrom ra bla dpon 'du ra yin//bod mi'i khromar pho mo'i rtsed ra yin//bod ma'i khrom ra btsun pa'i chos ra yin//bod ma'i khrom ra mi rigs tshong ra yin//— 209 —

dpe cha khur nas mgron khang btsal ba dang //chos gos mnab nas srang la nyul ba dang //phyag phreng 'dren zhor lug sha za ba sogs//ngo mtshar khyad 'phags ltad mo 'di na snang //kāng ṭ+wāṃg med par gog nur byed pa dang //( ༵ snye sdi~X ṭ+wāṃshā ༵ sbridro ༵ tār+shas////ngu bro skyo baṭ+wāṃ gtam rgyud 'di ṭ+wāṃ grags//༵tā rdo ṭāṅge/ rdzu~X ñchatrī 〉zlo rte/ ༵ sdodro ////g.yas g.yon gnyis nas khug ma khyer ba sogs//sngon med khyad mtshar mgron bsu 'di nas byed//sgor mo yod med dogs zon byed pa dang //gzhan la 'gro dus 'dug steg rtsod pa dang //gnas 'dir sdod skabs mgron khang btsal ba sogs//yid thang chad pa'i ngal ba 'di nas 'phyur//grong 'di'i gsang ba'i yon tan ma lus pa//'di 'dra tsam gyis rdzogs par mi nus mod//'on kyang cha shas tsam 'ga' brjod pa 'di//'gal med legs pa'i lam du 'gyur bar smon//nyis stong bzhi lo'i zla bcu gcig par zi ling du//— 210 —

ri 'dabs kyi tshor snangabartse chen nyi ma'i gzi 'od mkha' ru 'phags//grang lhag mun sogs dpung sde mthar sgrod byas//sa steng sems can lus la bde drod rgyas//nga cag skor mjal byed par mthun skyen baspun//mi mgo bcu phrag lhag las grub pa yi//dad ldan mjal ba'i phyogs khag chung chung de//dasbyi brel trīd par sbri maspyar swā/ gyis 'dzigs//trī bye trīsna ༵ py-i/ sna wadri ṭ+wāṃṭā byekā shāja//la//phyi na rdo brag nags tshal rgyan ltar bkra//nang na rang byon 'bur sku khri ma 'bum//ngo mtshar mig la 'khrul snang grangs med ster//kho bo'i bkra shis la nas ngal gso skabs//rkang lam du ma 'dres mtshams bzhi mdo der//brkyang phyag 'tshal mkhan rong mo skor zhig mthong //sems su 'di tshor spobs pa che 'o snyam//drin lan 'jal gnas phug pa chung ngu'i nang //khe sngon lam nas mthong gras mo zhig gi/'dzum te ha kyang bag yang lhod pa'i ngarji //211 —

a khu sems chung byed dgos zhes su gdams /nga yis phyogs der zhib lta byas pa'i tshe//bu mo'i mngon chung skyeng ba'i rnam 'gyur de'i//dbang rtsa hril bo sbrid dang chab gcig du//bod mo zhig gi thun min khyad chos rtogs //gnas ri chen po 'di yis yon tan gyis//bdag gis kho tshor rgyus lon thub song phyir//trī snalhaṭī r+sha sding rdo na ༵chosdon ma trī'i tsa ṭ+wāṃg ༵la skye//sa su//da dong tshe 'dir lan gcig 'phradasto phyir du//sprel rdzong brag na lha zhig yod srid na//gathin rje'i mkhan por cung tsam sgug rog zhes//tram̐ hūṃs byu byirdospra // zlo/ ṭ+wāṃtā ༵rno/ ska/ da bskur byas//zhib mor bris tshe mdzes nyams bral dog nas//don dngos brjod pa'i kha brda nyung bsdus 'di//mtho ris nyag chen kha nas gsal bor sma sa//nyis stong bzhi lo'i zla bdun par sprel rdzod nas//

'das zin pa'i phu gor phul ba'i mya ngan gyi satasmo thung /sngon chad cedro'adasazhesaparnalam dubargyud ngas//tshig tsam yin phyir snang dogachen po'idigamengs mod//da skabs 'grams kyi mi gcig35'dasis —ra —sa//don dngos yin phyir don gyi gnad zamijo༈gsadu song //nyisastongakrinyi1lorwa rgyang 1saphayuX du'abyor skabs//dāsbyakā sdi rjo) tram̐rwa shāṭī snaphrusdotāsngispraswesakyi phu bo'i//byerno na ṅgeṭ+wāṃ~X shā shā byesdo~X ṭ+wāṃje ༵༵ r+shar+shatrīthesgyu ra na sa////ṭīng khoX chung chung gnis poyadāyang dubarduspyarnoṭā//ṭāk+ṣiṃ shā dz+nyo / kyāsdo ༵ ṭ+wāṃ py-iṭā trīṭā kā~X drordo༄yang //phu bo dam pa'i thos rgyu ri bong ra'i zlasogatags//katrī spradā ༷kārwaXshā sdi ༷ snanadru3yeXdi'iring la//r+sha son paṭ+wāṃ byeṭ+wāṃ rte ṅgeṭ+wāṃrno ṅgebye~X tā dīṭ+wāṃXs re byas mod//bzod med sdug sga mchi ma snying gtingani/ṭāṭ+wāṃtā ṭ+wāṃ ༵/sa///bden rdzun glo bur 'byed dka'i rmila'e/gyikhrod nas//draspu pa'i ṭ+wāṃ de'i gzugs brnyan gsalaninganger mthong byung //bdan pa na snyam 'tham nas dasa'a'argodazhig byed skabs//— 2/3 ——

— ༵ḍāwartsabralaskyobasgrozlozlog zhakā—rmewa —tha ོ/ ——— —da phyogasamed 'gro ba kun la byam brtse de lda na zhing //ris nga zab mo'i rtog daphyod mthon po zhig ldan la //mi lo nyer lnga'i na tshod dar bab kyi sgang 'dir//nga yi phu bo bzang bo mi yul dang bral song //da lta nga rang 'jig rten mi yul 'dir yod la//phu bo 'di las gzhan pa'i gnas shig na yod stabs//dngos su 'phrad pa'i go skabs rtsa ba nas med rkyen//bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba bzod thabs shig mi 'dug/gtan du bral ba'i gzugs med rnam shes kyi phung bo//myur mgyogs rlung sbya'i tshul du spya ba ṣ+ṭṛ bdek+ta na//tā gā kāsdir zhir+shaphru rnyin —rgyu myu ༵/rjod —ṭ+wāṃg — phu la bo ba//—na nas//zhig /༵// stong bzhi lor phu bo dang lhan du sngon chad sdod myong sa'i sa cha

phu bo dam pad+ma rdo rje la phul ba/lo 'khor nyer lnga ma rdzogs sngon zhisme la//dbyug rta zhon nasadapung ba mnyam gshibs byas //sgra nag nang nas 'o zho mnyam 'thung byas//'brog phrug rgod po gnyis kyi rnamathar bskyangs//khyod rang nga las lus po che stabs kyis//nga yis sngon chad zhig nas phu bobatags//nga rang khyod las lus po chung stabs kyis//khyod kyis sngon chad zhig nas nubor snyam//bya ba gang zhig bsgrub par dam bcas tshe//rdo la ri mo bris ltar mi nyam pa//sngon nas da bar khyod kyi chos khon//nga ni tshul 'dir yid smon grangasamed skyes//nam khom dus su gleng mol byasapa na//khyod la thun mong min pa'i 'dodatshul mang //nga la rang lugs 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal che//mtha' ma ri spyang gnyis rjes bsnyegs dgos byung //rgyang ring sku lo'i mtshan byang phragan bajid/phug 'dun ldan pa'i thugs sne sgol phyosas//snying rje'i sgo rgo nas gzhan don khuraju len// da dung bu —da rjod la la rgya mnga'/ — 215 —

dus rgyun khor yug gcig na 'tsho skabs su//nga yis gzhung lugs klogs nas gnas lugs btsal//khyod kyis dngos don bsnyegs nas bden don rnyed//gal chen don la 'phrad dus pham mkhan nga //nga la snying rlung 'phar ba'i skabs re rer//lhag bsam ldan pa'i khyod kyi tshig re res//lus sems gnyis ka lhod pa'i skabs re byin//da lta bsam na bka' drin zhu dgos 'dug/pha yul phyogs kyi lung phug dog mo 'dir//rgyal pham 'gran rtsod byed mkhan ches mang yang //lhan skyes tshor ba rnon po de'i rkyen gyis//ang ki dang po khyod la thob bzhin 'dug/chung chung byis pa'i dus nas da reg bar//byung ba'i gnas tshul mang bo mchis mod kyang //phu bo khyod la dung ba zab drag pas /bstod pa tsam las ngag nas cang ma thon//nyis stong drug lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bcu nyin pha yul du////— 216 —

grogs la phul ba/si khron khams kyi sprul sku bdul 'dul mtshan//mtsho sngon a mdo'i mi rkyang rang 'bar ming //zlos gar 'khrab chung zhig gi rtsed mo'i khrod//dmar chung sems pa'i sne mo gcig du 'dres//khams kyi mkhan sprul 'ga' yi 'gro lugs dang /a mdo'i brnyan 'phrin zlos gar 'khrab lugs sogs//don snying ldan pa'i skad cha'i rnam grangs khrod//gsang ba'i gtam rgyud nged gnyis mgo la 'khor//dgung mo'i dus tshod bcu grangs yas mas su//shar phyogs lha khang dmar bo'i yang thog nas//dpa' rgod thog lha zhes pa'i lo rgyus zhig/sgra thag 'khor lor bkod pa dran e byung //gna' mi rnying ba dpa' bo yin min dang //da mi gsar bar brtse dung yod med sogs//khyed kyis skyo ba'i gleng gzhi mang bo'i khrod//nga yang mig chu shor ba thengs gcig min//mo ba rdzun ma'i mo lung ston pa dang //lha ba ngan pa'i lha lung 'beb pa sogs//ya mtshan cho 'phrul ston pa'i rdzu bag la//ngo rgol byed rgyur nged gnyis gsang gros mthun//—— 2/7 —

'khrab ston mkhan mo'i cha lugs mdzes min dang //'khrab mi gsar ba'i nyams 'gyur thon min sogs//'khrab gzhung re re'i gnas tshul mdor bsdus rnams//'khrab tshan zin bris byas pa grangs kyis dben//sdikā brnyan gsar ba'i lakā zlos byed skabs su//ṅge ṅgesnasna ṭ+wāṃ nātrī kātrī rītrī dī ṭ+wāṃrngosad / so//gas//da lta bsam na dngos gnas dgod re bro//pha bu gnyis kyi gsang ba'i gtam rgyud zhig/nged gnyis phar gleng tshur gleng byed pa'i skabs//khyed la skyo ba'i mig chu 'thor ba de//bsam na nga yang sdug bsngal gnas su 'god//gcig na bde mo 'jog pa'i 'dun pa dang //gnyis na rtsom bya tshar ba'i pham kha sogs//mnyam 'dzoms byas pa'i snang tshul de'i rkyen kyis//sgyu gu thang la mi 'jog thabs med byung //nyis stong gsum lo'i zla bcu bar pha yul du//

phu bo pad+ma tshe ring la phul ba/lo 'khor du ma'i bgrod lam ring mo yi khrod na//khyod la dga' skyo 'dres ma'i 'tsho ba dmang mod//dus rgyun yal med 'dzum mdangs lhan skyes su mnga' ba//khyod rang kho nar yod pa'i dam pa yi rang gshis//lta spyod 'gal 'du che ba'i 'brog yul gyi grong nas//ya rabs grogs kyi ngang tshul mdzes rgyan la spras te//mtho dman rgan gzhon kun dang lhan cig tu 'gro skabs//bdag sems mabur med rgod po khyod phyogs su shor song //cha med rgyang shāg ṭ+wāṃsdo ba'i mgo log gi ༵la nas//sduṭ+wāṃ ṭār+sha trīṭ+wāṃ kā brgyal rnyi ṭī nārnyi snadṛ shishe /ṭ+wāṃsdo /te///lcags tshan nam mkhar phyar ba'i gtam rgyud de dran nam//dgon pa'i mtha' grong dbus su lta skor la phyin dus//sna kādzosna/ tshoṭ+wāṃ /dh+ra chung ba'i rwab snasal gyi ji nas//trīn theng prel bye retre tā trīdro sna r+shak+tang /shā /snad /bro///mtshams rer bdag la skyo ba'i don rkyen re byung skabs//gzi bajid ldan pa'i gu bo'i las 'gan de 'chang nas//sems gso'i snying gtam phra mo shar shar du bshad pa//brjed med dran pa'i ngos na wa ya ler gnas yod//nga la mi nyag sras mo thob 'dod kyi ham sems//

khyod kyis nga la masgo skor satong 'dod kyi g.yo rgyu //mi mthun blo gnyis 'dres nas lta skor la bskyod skabs//glang rdzi bu mo mthong nas 'gal ba de dran nam//rma dgon chos 'khor gling du dgun chos la sdod skabs// rirgyagarasto/) pa'idīdzad pa // /sas nas bzung ste//trī rno // rted da papri rte drin k+tar byer d+nghadrasnar zhi sna/ /byos dang //khyod dang nga la byung ba'i gtam rgyud kyi don dngos//rgyas par brjod na blos mi dpog pa zhig 'dug mod//khyod la bcang ba'i brtse sems mtshon byed kyi tshab tu// mang nyung khyad med bsam nas 'di lta zhig bris so//nyis stong lnga lo'i zla bdun par mabo log nas//

blo rig ldan pa'i grogs por phul ba/rgyang ring sa mthar 'khyam pa'i dpon skor ba//rgyun du yul sdod byed pa'i chos ming can//lab gleng gang mang zhig gi sne mo nas//rgan gzhon nga gnyis bsam blo gcig mthun byung //nyis stong bzhi lo'i zla smad tsam zhig la//nga yis lta tshul gsar ba khyod la bshad//khyod kyis mig zung cer nas nga la nyan//the rang nag mo'i cho 'phrul skabs der bsnyan//khyod rang rgan pa yin phyir pha yi tshul//nga rang gzhon pa yin phyir bu yi tshul//pha bu'i bsam sbyor gcig du gyur nas bzung //nged gnyis bar na 'gal ba'i ming tsam med//chung dus slob grwa'i sgo mo ma brgal zhing //che dus gzhung mang slob sbyong ma byas par//bod yig chu tshad ha kyang mtho ba 'di//nga yis bltas na khyod kyi khyad chos lags//nga rang phyi phyogs slob grwar bskyod nas su//slar yang g.yon gzhas long bar thon thengs rer//yul mi'i kha brdar nyan tshe sun snang mang // — — 221 —

khyod dnga'aphrad skabs sems khungs dga' spro'ikheng // ——dubutshad gzhungala'ajugapakāyi3shis//zlosna kāspya dhi sbriwa kā tā kā' de ba rtend// kya gshis//nga yis ngo ma khyod rang brjed par dka'//tā9) kyis lo tshoda'adi'/5 sgogazhon srid na//trīkā kāpha/zlo'i maklisdo ༵tre ldawa ga/ṭā/sdo/ /sla mod//ngas kyang sems khur byas pa nyunganyung min//khyod kyis thonaram̐daphyogs la'abad pa gyis//trī / ༵ / r+shaṭ+wāṃ ༵je ṭāchi kā sdir+sha kā snrod////yang yang lhan 'dzoms 'byung ba'ismon lam 'debs//nyis stong lnga lo'i zla dang po'i tshes drug nyin phayul nas/

krogs por phul ba'i rgyang 'phrin/nyis stong lo yi skya reng thog ma gangs ri'i ljongs su ngomapa'i dus//nyams len phyogs la sbyang 'dod che ba'i gsang chen mtshan can khyed nyid dang //tshad ma'i skor la byang 'dod che ba'i ye shes ming can nga rang gnyis//shir seng chos grwa'i mgron po byed bzhin grwa khang zhig du mnyama'adzom byung //khyed kyis rgyu nora'abyor bar brten te mi rigs slobagasobasgrub 'dod zer//nga yis rgana' deng gzhung lugs sbyang nas khyed la rgyab skyor byed 'dod zhus//lo na chung yang bsam blo chen po'i 'jig rten hril bo kheb snyam shar//khang mig chung chung dgod sgras spur bzhin 'gyur med dam bca' snying la bkod//rgya nag yul du bskyod thengs re rer khyed la slob ma'i grangs ka mang //kharnyi chen rnams rīpar py-ibrel thengs re ne+er nga la tshaṭ+wāṃ ma~X so rtogs rgyal/༵/ byespya / ༵k+ta rdo ༵ rno/ sdu/trī /trī byeṭ+wāṃ trī ༵r+sha drokā ṭ+wāṃkā rnyipring// //mi dmangs shog sgor nyis stong lnga brgya 'phrin yig dang bcas ngal 'byor//tshad ma'i smad char rgyab skyor yin zhes zla tshes dang bcas bris nas 'dug/dran gdung mchi ma sems nas bzhur ba'in lhan 'dzom dus ston rol bar bsgug/nyin 'ag rgang mang phar la bskyal nas 'das pa'i bya bar phyiradran byas//nyis stongargasum lo'ilo mi da tsamal khyed rang gar byon cha ma 'tshal /nga la dmig yul ci yang med par brang khol chung chung sto nga sang nge /mig chu'i khyed la re 'bod byed bzhin 'khyam po zhig gi skye ba blang //

sems pa'i khyed la rgyang 'bod byed bzhin pha yu la phyogs la skor byas//dbu tshad gzhung la sbyang 'dod brtson sems sngon ltar nyam med gson por skrud/rig gnasagasar bar zhib 'jug byed sems sngon dang bsdur tshe lhag tsam yin//kā/kā nyitā da lta / nang gaṭ+wāṃng ga/ma gaṭ+wāṃ~X maṭ+wāṃg gang na bzhugasayodakyangakhye//nabye sa rte ḍi rte nā ṭ+wāṃ byerag rnyikā ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ kāsag/co lnga byen so ṅgeg yu gāran kān//nga mdzad par ma //

rang 'dzin grwa'i chos grogs tshor phul ba/las dbang btsan po zhig gi bkod sgrig dang //rten 'brel myur mo zhig gi mthun rkyen 'og/na len gnyis pa'i grong nas lhan 'dzoms byung //'tsho ba skyur po rol bzhin mnyam 'dug byas//'das song lo zla mang bo'i 'khor bskyod khrod//dga' ba'i dgod sgra lhang lhang grags zhor dang //sdug pa'i sme ngag shub shub 'don zhor du//grwa khang gcig nas gtam gleng byas pa mang //'brog ru thub bstan tshe 'phel rtsod la spro//mkhan po tshul khrims dpal 'byor dam bcar dga'//btsun pa ye shes chos 'grub dgag la dung //tshad smra ye shes rgya mtsho lan la zhen//the ba'i bde stong dbu mar bag chags rno//rdza ba bya dbyangs 'chad rtsod phyogs la 'jug/gā sasar kun bzang kha mtshar gtam la mkhas//phyag tsha u tshe bsam blo gtong bar goms//dge slong a da gzhung la bag chags zab//'jam dbyangs ming can phar phyin yig char 'dres//ye shes rdo rje'i tshad mar sbyang ba zhib//— 225 —

a khu bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan bsdus grwar phyogs//ma tsho sngon kar rmar mi gshis ya mtshar ldan//mtsho sngon bstan 'dzin rgya yig skor la mkhas//mtsho sngon 'od gsal 'dul bar cha rgyus zab//mtsho sngon chos grasas nyams len phyogs la byang //go re skam po'i zas bcud pho bar bstem//ras gzan yang mo'i gnyer ris phrag par 'khyil//'a/na 7 /na /'i sgra dad+dhings maṅgi' la 'phur//t+ta sa—sto rte bye ṭ+wāṃ'i / /r+sha kābye ṭīnā la ////

snying nye ba'i grogs por phul ba/'das pa'i lo ngo du ma'i yar sngon nas//nga dang khyod sogs grogs po chung chung 'gas//tshe 'dir 'bral med mna' tshig thog mar smas//dwangs gtsang byis pa'i bsam blo gcig du sprel//rkang gsum sbag sbag 'khor lo'i yang steng nas//gso rig bde ldan gling du bgrod skabs su//nga yis zhi khro'i kha byang 'grel ba de//da lta dran pa'i ngos na e 'dug grogs//mal khang gcig nas lhan 'dug byas pa dang //mal khri gcig steng mnyam nyal byed zhor du//sgrung gtam bshad nas gnyid du yur ba sogs//chung chung sa bas kyi sna nga tshul 'di ltar mchis//rgyang ring grogs por 'phrin yig 'bri dus su//rdo rje dril bu'i rnam thar gleng bzhin du//gal ta mgo thel yin rab bris pa rnams//khyod kyis da skabs soms dang ci 'dra 'dug/lo rgyus de dag legs par rdzogs pa'i rjes//mgo log 'jig med shes rig slob gling du//—— 227 —

gzhung lugs ngom med spyod pa'i skal ba thob//don ldan mi— tshe zhes pa de yi na snyam/ bgrang bya du ma 'gor ba'i nye char 'dir /grib ma nag po'i kha phyosas gleng bzhin du//smyu gu bzung nas gam la 'byor ba na//kho bo dal cig had tsam byed dgos byung //chung chung me tog 'thu rogs khyod nyid la//rtsom yig phyogs kyi bsam blo ldan pa 'di//mthong thos byung rjes bdag yid dga' skyo'i ngang //mig chu'i thig phreng bar med sa la 'thor//de ltar snying gi grogs po nor chung la//phul ba'i rten 'brel legs skyes nyung du 'di//chung 'dris grogs po khyod la dga' che stabs//ja thun gcig gi yun la shar mar bris//nyis stong lnga lo'i zla dang bor lung sngon du////— 228 —

rang tshogs pa'i tshogs mi tshor phul ba/'das pa'i lo ngo mang bo'i yar sngon du//nga tsho lhan cig gdan sa gcig la 'dzoms//dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang nas nyi ma bskyal//sems gtam sba gsang med par bshad res byas//nga rang rgyun du dpe cha lta bar spro//khyod tsho nam yang spo lo rtse bar dga'//nga tsho'i lta spyod cung tsam mi mthun mod//'ga' ba zhes pa'i tshig 'di ye nas dbe+en//khang chung de'i nang tshogs 'du 'tshogs thengs rer//nga la tshogs gtso zhig gi gzi dpal rgyas//khyed tshor tshogs mi zhig bi ngang tshul mngon//tshogs pa'i gsang ba'i gnas tshul gros bsdu ra byas//gsang ba'i don rnams phyi ru bsgrasas thengs rer//khyed tshor ci tshegs 'o brgyal shin tu che//nga yi sems kyi khur bo ha cang lci//nga tsho'i tshogs mi yongs la sdus bsngal mang //lo re'i lo gsar chen rngo rol ska bas su //nga tsho'i mjug ma/tha'i grub sbyarabras spyi bsdoms byas/ rgyal kha phar zhog pham kha sa mang bas// — 229 —

nga cho1) sems kyi sdug bsngal sngar bzhin mang //de nas mi lo 'ga' zhis song mtshams der//nga rang phyi phyosas yul la rgyang bskyod byas//khye1 tsho pha yul phyokās nas ṭām med 'dur//ṭ+wāṃ ༵ snadrokā nā ṅgidākātrī ldarte gālda dī cha//da//khyerngo tsho'i sna chas byas te kājirnyi rten gnyer//dro ༵ ṭā phrasdo~X zlor+sha ṭ+wāṃ~X sahwaṭ+wā ṅgezlo trīs////da lta nga yi lus phung ha kyang zhan//de'i steswā 'byung disags /da kyis rtag tu mnar//rnyi /dū rtesdu twe ༵ tre nā lha ༵dasho r+shab/sa bral//phyir dran thengs gcig rjes kyi 'bras rtags la//rang cag tshogs pa'i gnas tshul yig ngor bkod//'di la brten nas 'di 'brel grogs po tshos//de bzhin phyir dran thengs gcig byed par shog/nyis stong drug lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nyin pha yul nas////— 230 —

mjug gtam/spyir dus deb dang tshags pa ra sogs la lta bar spro ba ni nga rang nyid kyis gshis su grub pa'i lhan skyes kyi don zhig yin/de'i phyir lo 'khor 'di dag gi nang du ngas bod khul gyi dus deb dang / tshags par/ snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i snyan deb gsar ba sogs mang bo zhig la zhib lta thengs mang bo byas/ mthar bdag gis de dag las phal che ba zhig rdzun ma yin pa shes song bar ma zad de dag gi rtsom pa po dag kyang yon tan med pa'i lang shor sha stag yin pa shes song / de'i phyir 'bri stangs de dag bed trīd ṭ+wāṃs rtsom yigagro 'brikāṭ+wāṃ phyogasagyi la mos 'aspyanā megā motā 'on kyad+ngha snying rte ṭārmye trī / sad zlo da ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃtre dī ༵ tāṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃr+sha rnyi lha ṭ+wāṃwa sdowarnyi ṭ+wāṃ daṅgi rnyi /ṭ+wāṃr shād bzang bo sdo bar chad che/ dzopo zhig byas yosdo tshe ñchaṭ+wāṃs rgyakā ma baspyangs bye~X ṭāzlorno ṭaṃs tā/nga snar+shar nadī rā shā kās// ca//da ba ba —na pa d+nghad// sa
skru rge phro tshe —ṅkaXs+dzatrubam̐ /trī— tswa’ — wakhordzo ③ gyi pyomutswar+ṣadro+oX( ——① ༵ri 4r+shaX3miXdze+erdzodīwartewadwastsesda r+sājikhrine4mo byurtetre wa4tho— rdo5bye—kwa4 kā~X sgo 7 kyi
